jobs.title: Youth Ministry Project Coordinator for Parishes
jobs.description:
Job Overview

The Youth Ministry Project Coordinator for parishes provides leadership for the implementation of the Salesian Design–Serve–Reflect Initiative across the nine Salesian parishes of the USA West Province. This position strengthens parish youth ministry by accompanying parish leaders, mentoring youth, developing adult companions, coordinating service opportunities, and ensuring consistent implementation of the Province's youth ministry framework.

Working closely with parish staff, volunteers, and provincial leadership who support young people (ages 14–30\) to become missionary disciples through leadership, service, theological reflection, and active participation in parish life. The position also develops resources, evaluates outcomes, and helps build a sustainable and replicable model of youth ministry throughout the Province.

Work with Youth Ministry Delegate to assist in the coordination of pastors, associate pastors, and lay members at parishes. Support the coordinator of parishes to:

* Ensure the development, implementation, and evaluation of the Standards and Benchmarks of the Salesian Parish.
* Fostering communication and collaboration amongst the different parishes of the Province (emphasizing best practices).
* Supporting the ongoing formation of Salesians and laity who share responsibility for parish ministry, through meetings and moments of formation.
* Supports the Provincial Commission for Parishes and assists with province\-wide parish coordination.
* Serves as the primary administrative support for parish youth ministry initiatives.
* Assists with additional Province Youth Ministry initiatives as responsibilities expand.

This position is funded through a one\-year grant with the expectation of renewal based on funding availability and program success.

Add additional responsibilities under Youth Ministry as this position expands; they will take on other responsibilities, including formation, vocation, and other projects as they arise under the Youth Ministry Department.

Pay: $70,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Los Angeles, CA

jobs.description:
**Athena Coding** is an education company that provides after\-school enrichment programs in coding, STEAM, art, and other subjects for elementary and middle school students.

We are looking for a **Regional Program Coordinator** to support our Southern California programs. This is a **part\-time, hourly position** that combines remote administrative work with local travel to school sites and other locations throughout Southern California.

This is **not a fully remote position**. While much of the administrative work can be completed from home, you must live in the Los Angeles/Southern California area, have reliable transportation, and be comfortable traveling to locations including **Alhambra, Santa Ana, Rialto, and other nearby program sites as needed**.

Schedule

Approximately **20–25 hours per week**, with the potential for additional hours as our programs grow.

The schedule will vary from week to week depending on program needs. Most work takes place on weekdays, generally between **10:00 AM and 6:00 PM**.

Some weeks may involve more remote administrative work, while others may include district meetings, school visits, equipment/material deliveries, or other on\-site responsibilities.

Specific working hours will be scheduled based on operational needs. This is not a daily travel position.

Compensation

**$27–$32 per hour**, depending on experience.

**Mileage for approved work\-related travel between school sites, meetings, storage locations, and other assigned locations will be reimbursed in accordance with company policy.**

Responsibilities

* Serve as an operational point person for Athena Coding's Southern California programs
* Communicate with instructors, school\-site staff, and district partners
* Help coordinate instructor schedules, substitutions, and coverage
* Visit school sites to observe programs and address operational needs
* Attend occasional district or school meetings on Athena Coding's behalf
* Assist with onboarding and supporting instructors
* Follow up with instructors regarding training, compliance requirements, and program expectations
* Coordinate distribution and collection of curriculum materials, technology, and other program supplies
* Pick up, organize, or deliver materials from our local storage location as needed
* Help troubleshoot day\-to\-day program issues and communicate important updates to the appropriate team members
* Maintain organized records and track outstanding tasks and follow\-ups
* Assist with preparation for new program launches and transitions

We're Looking for Someone Who

* Is exceptionally organized and able to keep track of multiple programs and deadlines
* Communicates clearly and professionally by email, phone, and text
* Is dependable and comfortable taking ownership of tasks through completion
* Can work independently without constant supervision
* Is comfortable communicating with teachers, school administrators, instructors, and job applicants
* Is able to adapt when schedules or program needs change
* Has strong judgment and problem\-solving skills
* Is comfortable using Google Workspace and learning web\-based administrative platforms
* Has reliable transportation and is willing to drive throughout the Southern California region as needed
* Is comfortable occasionally transporting program materials or equipment

Experience in **education, after\-school programming, operations, staffing, recruiting, or program coordination** is preferred but not required.

Requirements

* Must reside in Southern California within reasonable driving distance of the greater Los Angeles area
* Reliable vehicle and valid driver's license
* Ability to travel to school sites and meetings as needed
* Availability during weekday business and after\-school hours
* High school diploma required; college degree or equivalent professional experience preferred

jobs.description:
**Company Description**  

NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world\-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad\-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry\-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations \& Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.


Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

 **Job Description**  

We’re looking for a creative, organized Social Media Coordinator to join our digital marketing team. Reporting to the Director, Digital Marketing, you’ll work with the Organic Social and Catalog Brand teams to create and edit short\-form videos, turn film clips into social content, engage with fans, and support campaigns across Universal Pictures All\-Access social channels.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

*Social Media \& Content Creation*

* Monitor social media platforms and engage with the Universal Pictures At Home community by responding to comments, messages, and mentions in a timely and professional manner, and flag sensitive issues to the appropriate team.
* Pitch, produce, and edit short\-form videos for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts, including in\-office shoots, and explain how ideas connect with the intended audience.
* Edit and repurpose film clips into shareable content optimized for each social platform.
* Support the Catalog Brand Team on holiday, anniversary, and other priority campaigns throughout the year.
* Track pop\-culture, social trends, emerging platforms, and new features to identify opportunities for relevant audience engagement.
* Curate, write, and distribute a weekly newsletter for the Home Entertainment team highlighting current digital marketing news and social media trends.
* Provide day\-to\-day support to the Organic Social Team to ensure smooth campaign execution, including building and updating presentation decks, highlighting campaign updates, performance results, and relevant trends.
* Manage all billing for the Organic Social Team, including vendor setup, invoice processing, purchase order creation and maintenance, payment tracking, and coordination with Finance to ensure accurate and timely payments.

*Influencer Marketing*

* Serve as the central day\-to\-day contact for influencer initiatives across New Release and Focus Features titles under the supervision of the Director, Digital Marketing.
* Maintain and expand the influencer database, keeping contact information, rates, audience insights, campaign history, and performance results current.
* Assist in identifying and recommending influencers based on campaign objectives, audience fit, and brand alignment.
* Support influencer outreach and campaign coordination, including availability, rates, deliverables, timelines, content approvals, and feedback, working with creators, their representatives, and agency partners.
* Develop campaign briefs ensuring alignment with approved campaign strategy and messaging.
* Compile social and influencer campaign results and recaps, identifying learnings and recommendations to improve future content and partnerships.

  

**Qualifications** **Basic Requirements**

* Minimum 1 year of experience in social media, digital marketing, video production, or a related field.
* Minimum 1 year of experience creating and editing short\-form video content for social media using tools such as Adobe Premiere Pro, CapCut, Final Cut Pro, or similar.
* Minimum 1 year of experience managing or supporting social media platforms (e.g., TikTok, Instagram, Threads, YouTube, X, Facebook, etc.).

**Desired Characteristics**

* Familiarity with pop culture and current and developing trends, with the ability to quickly spot opportunities and translate them into relevant content.
* Familiarity working with social media analytics tools (e.g. Sprouts Social, Hootsuite).
* Creative, proactive thinker who brings fresh ideas and follows through from concept to execution with the appropriate guidance.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to clearly communicate professionally with internal and external partners
* Collaborative and resourceful, with the ability to take ownership of day\-to\-day tasks while working under the Director’s guidance.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast\-paced environment

**Additional Requirements**

**Hybrid:** This position currently has a hybrid schedule, which requires contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week. The Company reserves the right to change in\-office requirements at any time.

jobs.title: Research Coordinator II
jobs.description:
The Department of Population and Public Health Sciences at the Keck School of Medicine at USC has an immediate opening for a bilingual (English\-Spanish) Research Coordinator II to assist in the *All of Us Research Program* funded by the National Institutes of Health. This position will report to the USC Principal Investigator.

***All of Us*** **Research Program Goals and Summary**


The *All of Us* Research Program is funded by the National Institutes of Health and part of the Precision Medicine Initiative. It seeks to build one of the largest, most diverse biomedical data resources of its kind, with information gathered from 1 million \+ participants across America. This program will be one of the most diverse health databases in history. Researchers will use the data to learn how our biology, lifestyle, and environment affect health. This may one day help them find ways to treat and prevent disease. *All of Us* is building a diverse database that can inform thousands of studies on a variety of health conditions.

**Job Responsibilities include but are not limited to**:

* Present the *All of Us* Research Program opportunity to eligible patients at Keck Medicine, LA General, and partnering clinics (in person or by phone).
* Interact with clinic staff as needed to create partnerships and increase support of the program.
* Help enroll interested participants by assisting with the consent process and survey completion through the *All of Us* research portal.
* Take physical measurements, vital signs and assist with biospecimen collection activities
* Contact potential participants to complete retention activities
* Use REDCap to document all patient contacts for both recruitment and retention


Performs other related duties as assigned or requested.

**Minimum Qualifications**:

* Bachelors Degree
* Willing and able to travel to off\-site locations approximately once a week
* Strong organization, attention to detail and verbal communication


Preferred Qualifications

* Bilingual (English and Spanish)


The hourly rate range for this position is $35\.53 \- $38\.34\. When extending an offer of employment, the University of Southern California considers factors such as (but not limited to) the scope and responsibilities of the position, the candidate’s work experience, education/training, key skills, internal peer equity, federal, state, and local laws, contractual stipulations, grant funding, as well as external market and organizational considerations.

  

Minimum Education: Bachelor's degree Minimum Experience: 2 years Minimum Skills: Administrative or research experience. Knowledge of medical environment and terminology. Knowledge and understanding of federal, state, and institutional research regulations as well as Good Clinical Practices (GCP) and HIPPA regulations. Proficient with MS Office applications. Demonstrated effective communication and writing skills. Ability to multi\-task. Demonstrated ability to work as part of a team as well as independently. Preferred Experience: 3 years Preferred Skills: Staff education and orientation experience. Knowledge of Electronic Data Capture (EDC) systems and Clinical Trial Management Systems (CTMS).

jobs.title: Account Manager, Branded Promotional Merchandise
jobs.description:
Most companies claim to have the best people. We say to them, "Keep dreaming." Our people are second to none. They set us apart with their entrepreneurial spirit and ambition. They come to us from the likes of Amazon, Microsoft, Nordstrom, Starbucks and the sports world, bringing energy, bold ideas and a willingness to dive into the unfamiliar. It's our people that make BDA the top global Merchandise Agency to work for.

**Position Summary**



In this role, you are both strategic and sales\-driven to manage and grow a portfolio of high\-value enterprise and hybrid accounts within the branded merchandise industry. This role requires a deep understanding of the promotional products space, strong enterprise\-level relationship management, and a proven ability to drive revenue growth through strategic planning, value\-driven selling, and cross\-functional collaboration.



You must be both a strategist and a closer and thrive on expanding client relationships, exceeding sales goals, and delivering creative solutions that align with brand compliance and client marketing objectives.


**LOCATION:**
* Candidates must reside within a commutable distance of Los Angeles, California, and be able to travel locally for in\-person client meetings as needed.


**Key Responsibilities**


**Strategic Sales \& Account Growth**

  


* Prepare and maintain an actionable strategic account plan using the OST model (Objective, Strategy, Tactics) for all assigned accounts focused on quarterly budget attainment (profit and margin results).
* Own and exceed sales and margin goals across assigned accounts.
* Identify new opportunities within existing accounts to drive incremental revenue through strategic prospecting and relationship building.
* Act as a trusted advisor to clients, aligning merchandise strategies with their broader marketing and brand objectives.
* Lead Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) and Account Business Reviews (ABRs), delivering insights, performance metrics, and strategic roadmaps.
* Forecast revenue and contribute to long\-term strategic planning for key accounts.
* Ensure data hygiene guideline compliance. Manage all opportunities, tasks, and key performance indicators to prescribed guidelines through insights from Salesforce CRM, promo and program performance analysis, and proactive recommendations.

  


**Client Relationship \& Brand Stewardship**

  


* Build and maintain strong relationships with client stakeholders, serving as the primary point of contact.
* Ensure full compliance with brand guidelines, contracts, and program standards.
* Deliver proactive, solutions\-oriented support to meet evolving client needs, acting as both consultant and problem\-solver.

  


**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**


* Work closely with Creative, Merchandising, Programs, Sales Ops, Supplier Relations, and other internal teams to deliver a best\-in\-class client experience.
* Develop merchandise strategies that reflect market trends and elevate the client's brand.
* Coordinate and manage multiple complex projects with varying scopes, timelines, and logistical considerations.

  


**Operational Execution**

* Ensure client pre\-sale, order and approval processes, supplier compliance standards and production timeline expectations are met
* Ensure all project communications, updates, and deliverables meet client and internal expectations.
* Accurately log and manage account activity in Salesforce to ensure full pipeline visibility and performance tracking.


**Client Events \& Onboarding**


* Successfully onboard new enterprise clients, ensuring a smooth and strategic launch.
* Coordinate and attend client events as needed, ensuring high satisfaction and brand alignment.
* Participation in departmental and other meetings as required
* Other duties as assigned by direct manager, sales leadership and/or executive team


**Qualifications**


* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or related field.
* 5\+ years of experience in the branded merchandise/promotional products industry preferred.
* Proven track record of sales success and strategic account growth.
* Exceptional communication skills — written, verbal, and interpersonal.
* Highly detail\-oriented with strong organizational and project management skills.
* Comfortable working independently and collaboratively in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment.
* Strong judgment, professionalism, and ability to navigate sensitive client interactions.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite; Salesforce experience strongly preferred.
* High level of curiosity, accountability, and a proactive, solution\-oriented mindset.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced, client\-focused environment.
* Willingness to travel approximately 50% of the time.


*We are pleased to share the base salary range for this position is $83,000 to $98,000\. If you are hired at BDA, your compensation will be determined based on factors that may include geographic location, skills, education, and experience. In addition to these factors, we believe in the importance of pay equity and consider internal equity of our current team members as a part of any offer. In the spirit of pay transparency, the range listed is the full base salary range for the role and hiring at the top of the range would not be typical, in order to allow for future salary growth. The range listed is just one component of BDA's total compensation and rewards programs, which includes: robust PTO; vacation, a paid volunteer day, holidays and summer Fridays, Benefits; medical, dental, vision, life, and AD\&D insurance, 401k; tuition reimbursement, mental health and financial wellness programs and professional development opportunities including tuition reimbursement. Certain revenue\-generating positions may be eligible for incentive compensation.*

  


**LI\-Remote**



\#LI\-LG1  

BDA is more than a workplace \- it's a family. For more than four decades we've promoted a vibran

jobs.title: Regional Account Manager, US HPP, Los Angeles, CA
jobs.description:
Location: Los Angeles, United States Job reference: R\-260598 Date posted: 09/24/2026
**Regional Account Manager, US HPP, Los Angeles, CA**


**This is what you will do:**


Professionally represent Alexion in educating HPP disease customers and identifying patients impacted by HPP and ensure high levels of visibility to Alexion’s disease awareness initiatives and a high degree of customer satisfaction in territory. Implement sales/marketing disease, diagnostic and branded programs. Maintain effective communication and relationships with key external and internal customers.


**You will be responsible for:**


* Consistently achieving or exceeding sales objectives in assigned territory
* Developing and maintaining in\-depth knowledge of the product, market, and customers
* Developing and implementing strategically targeted account\-specific territory business plans in line with corporate strategy that reflect an in\-depth understanding of local market forces impacting product sales.
* Managing territory, analyzing the market dynamics to ensure territory sales goals are met, and updating business plans to reflect knowledge.
* Developing and maintaining strong in\-depth clinical, technical, and scientific knowledge
* Seeking out and qualifying leads and profile new accounts
* Educating on the diagnostic approach to the disease leading to a successful differential diagnosis and appropriate testing of patient populations
* Appropriately utilizing marketing tools and resources including power point presentations
* Leading the implementation of our patient\-centric partnership model in assigned territory which will include physicians, their staff, , clinics, and hospitals and provide high level product expertise and customer service to all accounts
* Making compelling and persuasive sales calls to designated customers resulting in sales of Alexion products.
* Collaborate closely with stakeholders, including: TLL(s), SAL(s), MSL(s), FRM(s), Market Access, Diagnostics, andother respective Enterprise partners
* Proactively interacting with Alexion management to refine product and market initiatives
* Effectively and efficiently managing time, priorities, CRM tool, resources, and workload
* Managing administrative responsibilities, submit reports on sales activities accurately and on\-time
* Performing work in alignment with and adheres to all Alexion’s Code of Ethics and Business Conduct and Alexion policies and procedures.

**You will need to have:**


* Degree in life science and/or business/marketing
* Proven, documented track record for delivering consistent ‘Top\-tier’ sales results demonstrate a consistent track record of success (Top 20% performance).
* Minimum 5 years Pharmaceutical or Equivalent Experience (e.g. Biotech or Medical Device)
* Ability to work effectively both independently and collaboratively in a team\-oriented environment, on a consistent basis
* Ability to gain consistent access \& develop strong, professional relationships for scientific exchange and promotion with healthcare providers in community and academic centers
* Demonstrated strategic territory management successes
* Effective verbal and written communication skills and organizational abilities
* Valid driver’s license and clean driving
* Ability to travel (minimum 50\-60%) within assigned territory on a regular basis which will include frequent overnight and some weekend travel.
* The duties of this role are generally conducted in a field environment. As is typical of a field\-based role, employees must be able, with or without an accommodation to: travel by public transportation, automobile, train, or plane; work comfortably in a clinical setting; use a computer; engage in communications via phone, video, and electronic messaging; problem solve; engage in complex and non\-linear thought, analysis, and dialogue; collaborate with others; maintain general availability during standard business hours.

**We would prefer for you to have:**


* Advanced or master’s degree preferred
* Biopharma Experience
* Top tier awards preferred i.e. President’s Club Award.
* Strong preference for sales experience in one or more of following:
	+ Endocrinology and Medical Genetics specialties and/or experience selling to physicians specialized in treating bone disorders
	+ Enzyme Replacement Therapy products
	+ Orphan, Ultra\-Orphan or rare disease experience
	+ Nephrology, Orthopedic surgery and Rheumatology specialties
	+ Self\-injected product
	+ Institution/academic center account experience is preferred

**Date Posted**


24\-Sep\-2026
**Closing Date**


19\-Nov\-2026
Our mission is to build an inclusive environment where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and employees. In furtherance of that mission, we welcome and consider applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of their protected characteristics. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please complete the corresponding section in the application form.

jobs.title: Account Manager, West Coast
jobs.description:
**Hy\-Tek Intralogistics**
**Job Description**
**Job Title:** Account Executive
**Department:** System Sales
**Supervisor:** SVP, System Sales  

**Job Purpose:**
Contact existing or potential customers to promote new sales of material handling equipment and systems. Handle all sales development for specified products within the assigned territory – customer base. This includes the handling of customer concerns and complaints.  


**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**
* Develop and maintain annual sales plan. Present sales plan to supervisor and manage daily efforts toward plan.
* Manage and grow relationships with current customers. Regularly visit customer sites to understand customers operations; identify opportunities where the company can add value; introduce products, services, and solutions.
* Respond to all inquiries from users and suppliers.
* Develop new customer relationships by identifying business needs and growth plans, educating key decision makers, and recommending integrated solutions to achieve business goals.
* Anticipate customer needs and proactively customize solutions to meet customer’s business objectives. Inform customers of material handling technology trends.
* Work on multiple projects simultaneously, often with assistance from engineering and project management, but regularly complete small to mid\-sized projects independently. Collect data that accurately represents customer requirements. Develop concepts that range from manual to fully automated solutions.
* Develop proposals that include technical and functional descriptions. Present proposals to clients.
* Follow up on all proposals, negotiate, and close. Be certain that any changes or revisions regardless of the origins are well documented.
* Upon acceptance, process the order internally by transitioning the project to the engineering group and project management team. Introduce the project management team to the customer. Although the project management team will inform the customer of project status from installation to completion, start\-up and final payment, you should remain engaged through the process as needed.
* Work with our post project support team to offer customers after sales service and preventive maintenance plans.
* Utilize a Customer Relationship Management (CRM) tool to track the sales cycle.

  


**Knowledge, Skills and Abilities Preferred:**
* Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration or related degree is preferred
* 3 \- 5 years of experience in a technical or industrial sales role. Material handling systems experience and/or distribution operations experience would be a plus.
* Maintain accurate account development records and keep sales management informed of the status of each open project or recent sales proposal.
* Maintain a high degree of communication about customer proposals with engineering and sales support staff.
* Prepare equipment operational descriptions if required for specific projects.
* Experience in industrial capital equipment sales, selling six to seven figure solutions to Executives and Committees
* Great interpersonal skills – Displays honesty, ethics, and integrity at all times.
* Provide effective oral and written communications to customers, company management and co\-workers.
* Ability to organize a selling plan and exhibit time management skills
* Competency in time and account management
* Strong skills in prospecting, active listening, questioning, uncovering problems or client objectives, uncovering budget, understanding the prospect’s decision\-making process, proposal development and presentation, account retention, verbal\-telephone and written communication.
* Ability to read and understand building drawing, technical layouts, and equipment specifications. Proficiency with ACAD is a plus.

  


**Working Conditions:**
* Ability to travel up to 50% or as needed with fluctuation in intensity based on the phase of the project.
* Willingness to work extended hours to support proposal and contract activities.
* Working in office, warehouse, and manufacturing facilities.
* Working in a stationary position for an extended period.
* Moving or traversing for an extended period.
* Occasional ascending and descending scaffolding and/or mezzanines.
* Operating computers for an extended period.
* Possible exposure to noise levels exceeding recommended DBA levels.
* Occasional movement and positioning of objects weighing up to 75 pounds.

  


*\*\*\*Job requirements listed indicate the minimum level of knowledge, skills, and/or ability necessary to perform the job proficiently. This job description is not an exhaustive statement of duties, responsibilities, or requirements. Employees may be required to perform other job\-related duties as requested by their supervisor, subject to reasonable accommodations. \*\*\**

jobs.title: Employee Benefits Account Manager
jobs.description:
**Foundation Risk Partners****, one of the fastest growing insurance brokerage and consulting firms in the US, is adding an Employee Benefits Account Manager to their team in Orange, CA.**


**Job Summary:**



The Employee Benefits Account Manager is responsible for supporting the growth, retention, and servicing of employee benefits clients through proactive relationship management, exceptional customer service, and collaboration with producers, carrier partners, and internal teams. This client\-facing role serves as a trusted resource to clients while supporting sales initiatives, renewal strategies, benefit program implementation, and ongoing account management activities.


**Essential Functions:**


* Retain and grow an assigned book of business by delivering exceptional service and supporting client satisfaction initiatives.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, prospects, carrier partners, and internal stakeholders.
* Serve as a primary client contact, responding to inquiries and providing day\-to\-day account support.
* Support sales and business development efforts through prospect meetings, proposal preparation, cross\-selling opportunities, and onboarding activities.
* Coordinate and manage renewal activities, including gathering data, reviewing plan options, evaluating carrier proposals, and preparing client recommendations.
* Assist clients with benefit plan changes, employee communications, open enrollment support, and implementation activities.
* Educate clients regarding industry trends, legislative updates, compliance considerations, market conditions, and available insurance solutions.
* Develop and maintain service plans that align with client objectives and support long\-term retention.
* Partner with carrier representatives and internal teams to address service concerns, claims issues, enrollment challenges, and escalated client matters.
* Prepare stewardship reports, presentations, renewal reviews, and client\-facing materials.
* Ensure accurate documentation and maintenance of account information within agency systems.
* Maintain compliance with agency procedures, carrier requirements, and applicable federal and California regulations.
* Participate in team meetings, training initiatives, and professional development opportunities.
* Perform additional duties and special projects as assigned.


**Competencies \& Qualifications:**


* Minimum of 5 years of employee benefits account management experience.
* Active California Life, Accident \& Health Insurance License in good standing.
* Professional designation such as CEBS, RHU, REBC, GBA, or other industry\-related certification preferred.
* Strong knowledge of employee benefits products, including medical, dental, vision, life, disability, and voluntary benefits.
* Strong understanding of employee benefits compliance requirements and group\-size regulations including applicable state and federal laws.
* Experience supporting employee benefits sales, account management, renewals, and client service functions.
* Excellent relationship\-building and customer service skills.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to present information professionally to clients and prospects.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, including Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
* Prior experience with Epic, Sales Force, Ease, Employee Navigator and Wood \& Brown is preferred.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining attention to detail and meeting deadlines.
* Knowledge of employee benefits regulations and compliance requirements.

 **Disclaimer:**



While this job description is intended to be an accurate reflection of the job requirements, management reserves the right to modify, add, or remove duties from particular jobs and to assign other duties as necessary.


**Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO):**



FRP provides equal employment opportunity to qualified persons regardless of race, color, sex, religion, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, veteran status, or any other classifications protected by law.


**Benefits:**

FRP offers a comprehensive range of health\-related benefit options including medical, vision, and dental. We offer a 401(k) with company match, company paid life insurance, STD, LTD and a generous PTO policy starting at 18 days per year plus 10 paid holidays \& 2 floating holidays!

jobs.title: Entry Level Account Manager - Los Angeles, CA
jobs.description:
**Job Summary:** Medical Diagnostic Laboratories (MDL), a member of Genesis Global Group, is a CLIA certified clinical laboratory with multiple state licensing, specializing in state of the art, automated DNA based molecular analysis of a variety of chronic and infectious illnesses.
  
  

MDL specializes and performs Polymerase Chain Reaction (PCR) with a larger menu of testing available in the field of infectious disease. Our main theme of research is in the field of Gynecology, Infectious Diseases, Infectious Arthritis, Tick\-borne Diseases, Mycology, and Chronic Fatigue Syndrome (CFS).
  
  

MDL is looking to expand its sales force throughout the U.S. We are seeking a high\-energy, self\-motivated individual to join our sales team. As an Entry Level Account Manager, you will be responsible for maintaining a large client base of existing customers for MDL and serve as a liaison between management and customers to resolve any customer issues.
  
  

**Essential Functions:**  

* Grow client base revenues by presenting new test information, up selling and seeking out new sources of revenue from existing clients
* Establish positive long\-term client relations
* Educate and train clients, research problems and coordinate solutions between the laboratory and client
* Work closely with Senior Sales Executive and Regional Manager to identify client concerns and assist in the development and implementation of client retention strategies
* Monitor, evaluate, and report level of client satisfaction and recommend appropriate corrective action as required
* Maintain knowledge of competitors and their presence in assigned territory


**Job Qualifications:** General Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities (KSA’s) required
  
* 1\-3 years of successful customer service experience.
* Well\-developed multi\-tasking, organizational skills, and detail orientation are key to success
* Energy, motivation, enthusiasm, and integrity
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Must demonstrate sound judgment and decision\-making ability
* Computer proficiency in MS Office, Excel, e\-mail and internet functions
* Knowledge of laboratory testing and competing products.
* Must be able to travel within the coverage area and occasionally nationwide


**Physical Demands:** Physical, Mental and Workplace Environment Conditions
  
* Use hands to handle, control, or feel objects, tools, or controls
* Ability to sit, stand and walk
* Ability to drive motor vehicle


**Workplace Conditions:** Workplace Environment Conditions
  
* Requires frequent traveling by motor vehicle
* May be exposed to various workplace environments when meeting with customers


**Education and Certifications:**  

* Medical Assistant certification or Associate Degree, BA/BS preferred.


**We Offer:**  

* Competitive Salary
* Medical, Dental \& Vision Insurance
* Short and Long Term Disability
* Life Insurance
* Dependent Care Flex Spending Account
* Voluntary Policies (Accident, Hospital Indemnity, Critical Illness \& Supplemental STD)
* Identity Theft Protection
* 401(k) Plan
* Paid Vacation \& Holiday
* Business Professional Environment


Visit us at https://www.mdlab.com/
  
  

Medical Diagnostic Laboratories is a member of Genesis Global Group, an equal opportunity employer.

jobs.title: Social Media Manager
jobs.description:
**Outlandish Inc.** is a fast\-growing social commerce company and TikTok Shop Partner Agency helping brands, creators, and businesses grow through TikTok Shop, livestreaming, creator partnerships, content, and e\-commerce strategy.

We operate in a fast\-paced, highly creative environment where social media is at the center of what we do. We’re looking for a **Social Media Manager** who understands internet culture, knows what makes content perform, and can help build and grow the Outlandish brand across social platforms.

**About the Role:**

As our **Social Media Manager**, you will own and help execute Outlandish's day\-to\-day social media presence. This is a hands\-on role for someone who can think strategically while also jumping in to create, film, edit, post, and analyze content.

You should have a strong understanding of TikTok and Instagram, be comfortable identifying trends and turning ideas into engaging content quickly, and understand how to balance brand storytelling with performance.

We’re looking for someone who doesn't just follow trends, you understand why content works and can use performance data, audience behavior, and creative testing to continuously improve our social presence.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Develop and execute Outlandish's overall social media strategy across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube Shorts, LinkedIn, and other relevant platforms.
* Own and maintain the social media content calendar, including planning, scheduling, publishing, and coordinating content.
* Create engaging short\-form content from concept through execution, including filming, editing, writing captions, and publishing.
* Develop creative concepts, hooks, scripts, recurring content series, and social campaigns that align with the Outlandish brand.
* Stay highly informed on TikTok, Instagram, creator economy, e\-commerce, social commerce, and internet trends.
* Identify relevant trends and quickly determine how they can be adapted authentically for the Outlandish brand.
* Capture behind\-the\-scenes content from our team, offices, livestream studios, creators, events, and company initiatives.
* Collaborate with internal teams to identify stories, projects, events, milestones, and educational opportunities that can become social content.
* Manage community engagement, including comments, messages, mentions, and opportunities to interact with our audience.
* Monitor social media performance and track KPIs including reach, views, engagement, follower growth, watch time, click\-through rates, and other relevant metrics.
* Use performance data to identify what is and isn't working and make recommendations for future content.
* Continuously test different hooks, formats, posting strategies, creative concepts, and content styles.
* Help strengthen and maintain a consistent brand voice and visual identity across platforms.
* Monitor competitors and industry leaders to identify emerging trends, content opportunities, and best practices.
* Support social coverage for company events, creator activations, livestreams, and other special projects as needed.

**What We're Looking For:**

* 2\+ years of experience in social media management, content creation, digital marketing, or a related role.
* Strong understanding of TikTok and Instagram, including platform culture, trends, algorithms, and content best practices.
* Hands\-on experience creating short\-form video content for TikTok, Reels, and/or YouTube Shorts.
* Comfortable filming content using a phone or camera and editing short\-form videos.
* Experience with editing tools such as CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, or similar platforms.
* Strong creative instincts and an understanding of hooks, storytelling, pacing, and what keeps viewers watching.
* Ability to write engaging, platform\-appropriate captions and social copy.
* Experience managing a content calendar and maintaining a consistent publishing schedule.
* Comfortable reviewing analytics and translating performance data into actionable content decisions.
* Strong organizational and project\-management skills.
* Ability to move quickly, manage multiple priorities, and adapt when trends or business priorities change.
* Collaborative, proactive, and comfortable working across multiple departments.
* Strong communication skills and attention to detail.

**Nice to Have:**

* Experience working with creators, influencers, or UGC content.
* Experience growing a brand's social media presence organically.
* Familiarity with social media analytics and scheduling tools.
* Photography, videography, graphic design, or advanced video\-editing experience.
* Experience working in a fast\-paced agency, startup, creator, entertainment, or social\-first environment.

**What Success Looks Like:**

Success in this role means consistently creating content that strengthens the Outlandish brand, grows our audience, increases engagement, and keeps our social presence relevant within the rapidly changing world of social commerce.

You’ll be expected to bring ideas to the table, take ownership of execution, pay attention to performance, and continuously look for ways to make our content better.

**Why Join Outlandish?**

At Outlandish, you'll be working directly within the rapidly evolving world of TikTok Shop, creators, livestreaming, and social commerce. You'll have the opportunity to experiment with new ideas, create content around an exciting and growing industry, and play an important role in shaping how the Outlandish brand shows up online.

**If you're creative, social\-first, data\-aware, and always thinking about the next piece of content, we'd love to hear from you!**

Pay: $65,000\.00 \- $72,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Paid time off

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Santa Monica, CA 90401

jobs.description:
### **Description**

  

Astrana Health is seeking a Business Development Representative \- ACO Growth to drive top\-of\-funnel growth and new partner acquisition for the organization’s Accountable Care Organization (ACO) initiatives. This role focuses on outbound prospecting, lead generation, and meeting development with physician groups, independent practices, and healthcare organizations interested in participating in value\-based care and ACO programs.  

  

Reporting to the Senior Director of ACO Growth, this BDR plays a critical role in building the  

organization’s ACO pipeline by identifying qualified opportunities, initiating conversations with prospective partners, and supporting the sales process through follow\-up, relationship nurturing,  

and meeting coordination. As the role ramps and performance milestones are achieved, the BDR  

may also lead select smaller opportunities through the closing process, supporting expansion of  

the ACO network and physician participation. This position requires a high\-energy,  

entrepreneurial sales mindset, strong communication skills, and a genuine interest in healthcare transformation and value\-based care.  

  

We are seeking candidates who are located in Southern California. Travel to physician practices across the West Coast will be required for this role.  

  

Our Values:  

* *Patients First*
* *Empowering the Independent Provider*
* *Be Innovative*
* *Operate with Integrity \& Deliver Excellence*
* *Team of One*
  

### **What You'll Do**

  

* Analyze market dynamics, provider landscapes, and competitive positioning to identify high\-value partnership opportunities
* Evaluate prospective providers based on strategic fit, growth potential, and alignment with value\-based care objectives
* Prioritize outreach and engagement efforts based on market needs, organizational goals, and potential return on investment
* Provide recommendations to leadership on target markets, provider segments, and outreach strategies
* Develop and execute targeted outreach strategies for engaging physician groups, practices, and healthcare organizations
* Lead initial engagement discussions with prospective partners, presenting value\-based care offerings and partnership opportunities
* Tailor messaging and engagement approaches based on provider type, size, and market conditions
* Build and maintain relationships with key stakeholders to advance partnership discussions
* Own and manage a pipeline of prospective ACO partners, ensuring alignment with strategic growth priorities
* Exercise judgment in advancing, pausing, or deprioritizing opportunities based on evolving business needs
* Lead follow\-up strategies and engagement plans to move opportunities through the pipeline
* As appropriate, independently manage lower\-complexity opportunities through later stages of the sales cycle
* Partner with internal stakeholders including Network Management, Operations, and Clinical teams to align partnership strategies
* Provide input into proposal development, partnership structuring, and engagement approaches
* Influence internal decision\-making by providing insights on provider needs, market trends, and competitive dynamics
* Analyze outreach effectiveness, pipeline conversion trends, and engagement outcomes to refine strategies
* Identify opportunities to improve messaging, targeting, and engagement tactics
* Provide data\-driven insights and recommendations to leadership to enhance ACO growth performance
* Conduct in\-person meetings, site visits, and presentations with prospective provider partners
* Represent the organization at industry events, conferences, and networking opportunities
* Serve as a market\-facing representative to support brand awareness and relationship development
* Other duties as assigned

  

### **Qualifications**

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Healthcare Administration, Marketing, or related field
* 2\+ years of experience in sales development, business development, or inside sales
* Strong prospecting, outreach, and relationship\-building skills
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Ability to manage high volumes of outreach activity and maintain strong organization
* Proficiency with CRM tools and Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook)
* **Orange County resident preferred**
* **Bilingual Vietnamese preferred**

You're great for this role if you have:* Experience in healthcare, physician practice sales, managed care, or value\-based care
* Knowledge of ACO models, population health, or healthcare payment reform
* Experience with outbound prospecting tools such as Salesforce, HubSpot, Outreach, or  

 similar platforms
* Strong sales prospecting and lead generation capability
* Ability to build rapport quickly with physicians and healthcare leaders
* Highly motivated with a results\-driven mindset
* Strong follow\-through and attention to detail
* Comfortable operating in a fast\-paced startup\-style growth environment
* Ability to work independently while collaborating with senior leadership

### **Environmental Job Requirements and Working Conditions**

  

* This is a full\-time position. Working across time zones will be required per business need.
* This is a hybrid position, where you will be working remote with required travel across the US, predominantly across California/West Coast. Travel is expected up to 30% for the first year, however, we are seeking candidates who are interested in growing into a larger\-capacity role after year 1 with more frequent travel.
* The national target compensation for this position is $80,000 \- $120,000 annually, between base salary and bonus structure. Compensation will be comprised of a base salary between $80,000 \- $93,000 per year, as well as a performance\-based bonus structure. Actual compensation will be determined based on geographic location (current or future), experience, and other job\-related factors.

jobs.title: Business Development Representative
jobs.description:
HiveWatch is a tech\-forward, inclusive organization fostering the evolution of the physical security industry. We are a diverse team of forward thinkers who empower each other to find creative and collaborative solutions in an industry ripe for modernization. We are passionate about the problems we’re solving for our customers and equally passionate about the company we’re building.


HiveWatch is here to help security teams pivot from chasing threats to preventing them. We protect organizations, people, and property through the intelligent orchestration of physical security programs. With better communication, more insights, and less “noise”, we are modernizing what it means for businesses and their employees to truly feel safe.

* **Funding \& Growth Momentum** HiveWatch recently closed a $33M Series B, bringing total funding to over $65 million. The company is entering "Phase 2: Scale" with multiple Fortune 500 customers secured. 95% of Americans have interacted with a product, service, or brand protected by HiveWatch.
* **Founder with Deep Industry Expertise** Ryan Schonfeld, Founder \& CEO, began his career as a police officer and investigator before leading Global Security and Safety Technology at Fox Group. He founded HiveWatch to disrupt an antiquated physical security industry with AI\-powered tools that free security operators from false alarms to focus on real threats.
* **Cutting\-Edge AI Technology** Security leaders are under tremendous pressure to modernize their function using AI, and HiveWatch is uniquely positioned to automate 90%\+ of alarm responses for organizations, transforming how enterprise security teams work.
* **Culture of Ownership \& Impact** This is an environment where you can take genuine ownership, build meaningful relationships, and deliver results quickly. If you want to help build and scale a rapidly expanding sales organization with a real path to advance your career, this is the place.
* **Direct Access** Partner directly with the VP of Sales, you'll work within a lean org structure with direct access to the Founder and senior leadership team to help shape the company's growth.
* **Relationships That Matter** Our Customers aren’t just clients \- they’re long\-term partners. We value *birthday cards over business cards* and pride ourselves on building genuine relationships that drive trust and growth.

**About the Role:**


As a Business Development Representative (BDR), you will be responsible for generating and qualifying pipeline for HiveWatch’s enterprise sales team. You will engage with physical security leaders at large organizations, introduce them to HiveWatch’s AI\-powered platform, and create high\-quality opportunities for the team.


This role is ideal for someone early in their sales career who wants exposure to enterprise SaaS, complex sales motions, and clear advancement opportunities into an Account Executive role over time.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Prospect into target enterprise accounts with 1,000\+ employees using outbound email, phone, LinkedIn and other creative outreach strategies
* Identify and engage key stakeholders including GSOC directors, physical security leaders, and risk management executives
* Qualify inbound and outbound leads to assess fit, urgency, and buying potential
* Book qualified meetings and hand off opportunities to Enterprise Account Executives
* Maintain accurate CRM data and consistently track outreach, activity, and pipeline metrics
* Collaborate closely with AEs to align on account strategy and messaging
* Continuously refine messaging based on market feedback and enablement guidance

jobs.description:
Chapman University’s renowned Dodge College of Film and Media Arts, located in the heart of vibrant Orange County, California, seeks dynamic and passionate candidates for a full\-time, non\-tenure\-track faculty position in Public Relations, Advertising, and Entertainment Marketing (PRAEM). This position begins August 1, 2027\.


Chapman University is a nationally ranked, R2 Carnegie Classified, private institution offering traditional undergraduate and graduate programs in the heart of Orange County, one of Southern California’s most diverse and vibrant regions. Chapman’s campuses are home to nearly 10,000 students representing 50 states, 4 territories, and 76 countries. The 11 schools and colleges of Chapman, including Dodge College of Film and Media Arts, offer 50 bachelors, 29 masters, and 8 doctoral programs, along with nearly 75 minors and 19 accelerated and bridge programs. Classes are taught by the more than 1,100 dedicated faculty members who are leaders in their fields, including Nobel Prize recipients, MacArthur Fellows, National Medal of Science honorees, former U.S. Supreme Court clerks, and Emmy, Grammy, and Academy Award winners.


Dodge College is dedicated to forward\-looking, personalized education, we create an environment for unlimited student and faculty achievement. Industry trade publications The Wrap and The Hollywood Reporter rank Dodge College \#4 among film schools nationwide. More information about the Dodge College of Film and Media Arts can be found at chapman.edu/dodge .


The PRAEM Program at Dodge College of Film and Media Arts \- The award\-winning Public Relations, Advertising, and Entertainment Marketing program offers students a robust curriculum focused on storytelling. The curriculum combines theory with applied industry\-focused learning, strategy, research, creativity, campaign development, digital and social media, and presenting. AI and emerging technologies and the rapidly evolving ways organizations and brands engage audiences are also considerations. Students develop an understanding of the opportunities, limitations, ethical considerations and responsible application of AI and emerging technologies within contemporary communications. With over 250 undergraduate majors and an additional 200\+ students minoring in Public Relations or Advertising, the program provides a dynamic and growing academic community. Students gain hands\-on experience in industry practices, preparing them for successful careers in entertainment marketing, public relations, advertising, digital marketing and related fields.


**Responsibilities:**

* Teach undergraduate courses with a focus on Advertising, with the ability to teach additional courses within Public Relations and Entertainment Marketing based on program needs and the candidate’s expertise.
* Carry a 24\-credit annual teaching load, typically structured as a 4/4 teaching schedule, with four courses taught each semester.
* Teach introductory and advanced courses that integrate theoretical foundations with strategic, applied, and current industry practices.
* Incorporate appropriate applications of AI and emerging technologies into coursework while developing students’ ability to critically evaluate their use, limitations, ethics, and impact on the profession.
* Mentor and advise students in the PRAEM program and support their academic and professional development.
* Contribute to curriculum development and the continued evolution of the PRAEM program and its curriculum.
* Participate in service to the college and university, including committee work, student initiatives, recruitment, and outreach activities.
* Maintain currency in professional practice relevant to advertising, public relations, marketing, or entertainment media.
* Incorporate global and cross\-cultural perspectives into teaching, case studies, campaigns, and student work.

  
**Required:**

* An advanced degree (master’s or Ph.D.) in Public Relations, Advertising, Marketing, Film, or a related field, OR substantial professional experience and demonstrated expertise relevant to the position.
* Experience in teaching, either at the university level or in the industry.
* Experience in several relevant areas, such as advertising strategy, campaign development, creative strategy, consumer/audience research, digital and social media, presenting and pitching, and campaign measurement.

**Preferred:**

* Ability to translate professional or academic expertise into applied, real\-world classroom learning.
* Experience working with global brands, international markets, multicultural audiences, or cross\-cultural campaigns.
* Ability to teach primarily in Advertising while contributing to Public Relations and Entertainment Marketing courses based on program needs.
* A demonstrated commitment to both teaching excellence and continued professional development in the field of public relations, advertising, or entertainment marketing.

  
Chapman University is an equal opportunity employer that provides equal employment opportunities to all individuals, regardless of their protected characteristics. All qualified applicants and employees are encouraged to apply and will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, military and veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, genetic information or any other characteristic protected by state or federal law.

Kitchen \& Bath Designer / Project Coordinator

Pacific Coast Custom Design is an established Orange County residential remodeling and custom cabinetry company with nearly 40 years of experience and an in\-house cabinet shop.

We are seeking an organized, detail\-oriented designer who can develop thoughtful designs, communicate confidently with clients, and coordinate the details that turn a design into a successfully completed project.

This position combines hands\-on design work with estimating support, client selections, and project coordination. It offers hourly base pay plus project profit bonuses.

What You’ll Do

* Develop kitchen, bathroom, custom cabinetry, and residential remodeling designs that reflect each client’s needs, budget, and home.
* Prepare dimensioned layouts, elevations, cabinetry drawings, specifications, and 3D presentations.
* Take and document field measurements and coordinate verification with the shop and installation team before production.
* Guide clients through material, finish, fixture, hardware, and accessory selections, keeping decisions organized and on schedule.
* Help prepare detailed scopes of work, estimates, material quantities, and vendor pricing for management review.
* Coordinate design information, approved selections, purchasing details, and material lead times with the office, cabinet shop, field team, and vendors.
* Maintain accurate project records, including drawings, selections, client approvals, schedules, and outstanding decisions.
* Provide timely client updates and follow through on questions and commitments.
* Identify scope changes, prepare change\-order information, and obtain required approvals before additional work proceeds.
* Monitor assigned project budgets and flag potential cost overruns, missing information, or scheduling problems early.
* Support project completion and punch\-list coordination while maintaining quality and client satisfaction.

What We’re Looking For

* Practical experience in residential kitchen and bath design, custom cabinetry, or remodeling design.
* Proficiency in design and drafting software, with the ability to produce clear, dimensioned drawings and 3D presentations.
* Understanding of cabinetry construction, materials, finishes, and installation considerations.
* Strong organization, attention to detail, and the ability to coordinate multiple projects at different stages.
* Professional client communication and a dependable approach to follow\-through.
* Comfort working with estimates, budgets, vendor quotes, and project\-management software.
* Ability to attend in\-person meetings and visit local project sites and vendor locations.
* A portfolio that demonstrates both design ability and technical drawing skills. Relevant experience and demonstrated ability are valued.

Compensation and Work Structure

This is a W\-2 hourly position with additional project profit bonus opportunities.

The incentive structure provides a share of qualifying project profit above a 10% project profit margin. Qualifying profit accounts for defined project costs, allocated payroll, and company overhead. The percentage, calculation method, eligibility, and payment terms will be provided in a written incentive plan before employment begins.

We value accurate estimating, efficient coordination, quality workmanship, and successful project completion. Final pricing and major commitments are subject to management approval.

Employees work within an agreed schedule, accurately record all hours worked, and obtain advance approval for overtime. All hours worked are paid in accordance with applicable law.

How to Apply

Please submit your resume and a portfolio or work samples. Include examples of dimensioned drawings or cabinetry details, along with photographs or renderings of relevant projects. Briefly describe your role in the examples and the design software you use.

jobs.title: Logistics Coordinator – Air & Ocean Operations
jobs.description:
1\. Position Overview

The Mobile Business Unit supports the global distribution of mobile devices with a focus on speed, reliability, and operational efficiency. The Logistics Coordinator (Air \& Ocean Operations) is responsible for planning, executing, and continuously improving inbound and outbound air and ocean freight operations, ensuring shipments move efficiently from manufacturers to warehouses and ultimately to customers.

This position requires hands\-on experience in Air or Ocean Freight Operations, along with solid ocean freight knowledge. As our operation supports global transportation across multiple time zones, this position follows a five\-day work schedule that includes weekend shifts based on operational requirements.

2\. Key Responsibilities

1\) Planning \& Scheduling

* Create and maintain daily tracking reports for Air Export, Ocean Import and OTR including weekend operations

2\) Port \& Terminal Coordination

* Gather departure information for containers and air cargo at ports, terminals, and airports.
* Monitor and confirm on\-time departures from U.S. Ocean terminals and major airports.
* Coordinate terminal departure schedules with terminal operators and customs brokers.

3\) Movement Monitoring

* Track ocean containers, rail intermodal units, and air shipments in real time.
* Validate Import of Documentation (IOD) and Proof of Delivery (POD) on a daily basis.
* Respond promptly to shipment exceptions requiring immediate attention (e.g., delays, damages, customs hold).

4\) Transload Warehouse Management

* Oversee Transload Warehouse (TW) capacity planning and utilization.
* Manage Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) for transload operations (e.g., dwell time, on\-time transload, damage rate).
* Identify and resolve operational bottlenecks and work with warehouse teams to implement corrective actions.

5\) TL OB OTR Dispatch Management

* Schedule and dispatch Truckload (TL) Outbound (OB) orders using the Transportation Management System (TMS).
* Optimize routing and load consolidation to meet service\-level agreements while minimizing transportation costs.

6\) Partner \& Stakeholder Communication

* Serve as the primary point of contact for logistics partners, including carriers, freight forwarders, customs brokers, internal supply chain teams, and customers.
* Handle claims, documentation, and issue escalations through phone, email, or virtual meetings.

7\) Compliance \& Documentation

* Ensure all shipments comply with international trade regulations, hazardous material requirements, and security standards.
* Maintain accurate records for audits and regulatory inspections.
* Perform other job\-related duties as assigned.

8\) Core Competencies

* Analytical Thinking: Translate large data sets into actionable insights.
* Problem Solving: Quickly identify root causes of operational issues and implement effective solutions.
* Communication: Communicate clearly and effectively with internal teams and external partners.
* Multitasking: Manage multiple priorities while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail.
* Ability to Work Under Pressure: Perform effectively in a fast\-paced, deadline\-driven environment.

3\. Requirements (Basic Qualifications)

1\) Education

* Bachelor's degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, or a related field.

2\) Experience

* Minimum 6 years of experience in logistics coordination, with a strong focus on international air and ocean freight operations.
* Hands\-on experience in international Air, Ocean, and OTR freight forwarding operations is required
* Proven experience managing transload warehouse operations and Truckload (TL) dispatch.

3\) Industry Knowledge

* Strong understanding of international air and ocean freight regulations, and customs procedures

4\) Technical Skills

* Proficiency with ERP and logistics systems (SAP, TMS, WMS or equivalent).
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP.

5\) Language

* English

6\) Weekend work may be required.

Experience:

jobs.description:
**Project Coordinator \- Document Control**


**Location:** San Jose, CA, United States — 100% On\-Site  

**Job Type:** Full\-Time, Salaried \| Project\-based assignment scheduled through Q3 2028  

**Schedule:** Full\-time at the project site  

✈️ **Travel:** Minimal; occasional local travel within Santa Clara County  

**Salary Range:** $80,000–$100,000 annually (based on relevant experience, skills, and qualifications; base salary only)  

**Benefits:** 100% Employer Paid Medical, Dental, Vision \| 401(k) Match \| PTO \& Holidays \| Paid Lunch \| Commuter Benefit

 **About Us**


SK AX USA, Inc. delivers specialized IT, infrastructure, and digital transformation services across the United States. We support large\-scale, mission\-critical programs involving advanced infrastructure, operational technology, and next\-generation AI environments.


For this program, we represent the owner’s technology organization, translating AI infrastructure requirements into facility specifications and verifying that construction meets those requirements.


**Learn more:** https://www.skaxusa.com/

 **Position Overview**


We are seeking an experienced **Project Coordinator \- Document Control** to oversee project documentation and support on\-site coordination for a large\-scale AI data center construction program in San Jose, California.


As one of three full\-time resident staff members, you will own the document control function and coordinate the flow of information among the general contractor, construction owner’s representative, technology partner, and systems integrator. The program spans four construction phases through Q3 2028\.


Your responsibilities will include revision control, submittal tracking, meeting coordination, inspection and commissioning records, permitting documentation, and project turnover. You will ensure project information remains accurate, current, traceable, and accessible throughout the program.


This role requires hands\-on ownership, sound judgment, and the ability to coordinate across organizations while working closely with project leadership and technical teams.

 **Key Responsibilities**

 **Document Control \& Configuration Management**

* Maintain version and revision control for drawings, specifications, technical requirements, and interface control documents.
* Manage document issuance and distribution, track approval status, and ensure teams can clearly identify the current revision.
* Publish and maintain the configuration register weekly.
* Issue revision notices to affected stakeholders and maintain a traceable record of document changes.

 **Multi\-Party Submittal Coordination**

* Receive, register, and distribute deliverables from the general contractor, construction owner’s representative, technology partner, and systems integrator.
* Maintain a daily submittal intake register and monitor outstanding or overdue deliverables.
* Follow up with responsible parties and escalate delays before they affect project milestones.
* Flag inconsistencies between organizations’ documents for review by the technical team.

 **Meeting Coordination \& Action Tracking**

* Coordinate approximately 10–15 recurring and ad hoc meetings per month, including contractor coordination meetings, owner reviews, and phase gate sessions.
* Prepare and distribute agendas and pre\-read materials.
* Produce and distribute meeting minutes within two business days.
* Maintain action item registers, including responsible owners, due dates, and closure evidence.
* Follow up on open actions and escalate overdue items to project leadership.

 **Inspection \& Commissioning Records**

* Document factory testing, site testing, and integrated system testing activities, including attendance, observations, photographs, and test reports.
* Maintain non\-conformance report (NCR) and punch list registers through closure.
* Assemble evidence packages supporting the owner’s technical acceptance assessments at each phase gate.
* Coordinate with engineering and field teams to maintain complete, traceable inspection and commissioning records.

 **Permitting Documentation**

* Compile and track permit submittal packages.
* Log comments, correction requests, and outstanding conditions from permitting authorities.
* Maintain approval histories and communicate documentation status to the project team.

 **As\-Built Documentation \& Project Turnover**

* Receive and catalog as\-built drawings and operations and maintenance (O\&M) documentation.
* Track documentation completeness and follow up on missing or incomplete submissions.
* Maintain the turnover deficiency list through project closeout.
* Organize final documentation packages for handover to the owner.

*Technical review and acceptance of as\-built documents remain the responsibility of the engineering team. This position manages document receipt, cataloging, and completeness tracking.*

 **Qualifications**

 **Required Experience**

* Three or more years of document control experience on construction or data center projects.
* Hands\-on experience with an electronic document management system such as Procore, Aconex, Autodesk Construction Cloud, SharePoint, or an equivalent platform.
* Demonstrated experience preparing meeting minutes and tracking action items in a technical environment.
* Ability to follow engineering discussions and accurately summarize decisions, responsibilities, and next steps.

 **Technical \& Language Skills**

* Professional fluency in both English and Korean is required. English is used daily with contractors, consultants, and vendors; Korean is used daily with the owner’s technology organization and headquarters.
* Strong capability in document revision control, approval tracking, and records management.
* Ability to organize technical documentation and maintain accurate registers across multiple project stakeholders.

 **Communication \& Coordination Skills**

* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

jobs.description:
Under the supervision of the Principal Investigators, Clinical Research Manager, and Senior Study Coordinators, the Assistant Clinical Research Coordinator supports the day\-to\-day coordination of the Pediatric Epilepsy Center of Excellence clinical research portfolio. The position supports industry\-sponsored and investigator\-initiated clinical trials, including gene therapy, antisense oligonucleotide, and small\-molecule studies, as well as prospective observational and longitudinal natural\-history studies. This is a hybrid role requiring a minimum of three days on site at the UCSF Mission Bay Campus each week.


Working closely with senior coordinators, investigators, clinical teams, sponsors, and coordinating centers, the incumbent supports recruitment and retention, research visits, informed\-consent preparation under investigator direction, data and regulatory documentation, research specimens, monitoring visits, and study start\-up and closeout activities. The role is family\-centered, conducted under close supervision initially, with increasing independence with demonstrated competency.


The research population includes infants, children, and adolescents with complex neurologic disorders, including epilepsy. The incumbent must be comfortable engaging warmly and professionally with children of all ages, including newborns and young infants, and with their parents and caregivers. This role requires sensitivity to the demands placed on families managing medically complex conditions, excellent communication skills, and an ability to make research visits organized and family\-centered.


  
Required Qualifications:


* High School Diploma; or equivalent experience
* Demonstrated ability to organize competing priorities, maintain accurate records, and manage detail\-oriented work reliably and on time
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate respectfully and effectively with children, parents, caregivers, and multidisciplinary clinical and research teams
* Proficiency with standard office and data\-entry applications and the ability to learn study databases, electronic health record systems, and other research tools
* Ability to work collaboratively in a fast\-paced pediatric clinical environment, exercise sound judgment, maintain confidentiality, and follow approved protocols and institutional procedures
* Willingness to complete required training in human\-subjects protection, Good Clinical Practice, privacy, and study\-specific procedures
* For studies involving investigational drug delivery or other study\-related procedures in the operating room, the incumbent may assist with non\-clinical research coordination before, during, and after the procedure. The coordinator must be comfortable working in the operating\-room environment and adhering to all applicable infection\-control, privacy, procedural, and safety requirements. Duties may include confirming study documentation, coordinating research samples or study materials, communicating with the procedural and clinical teams, and documenting protocol\-required activities. The incumbent will not perform clinical or sterile\-field duties unless separately qualified, credentialed, and authorized to do so
  

Preferred Qualifications:


* BS Degree in related science
* Prior experience in clinical research, research coordination, or a health\-care setting, particularly within an academic medical center
* Experience working with pediatric patients and families, especially those affected by epilepsy, neurologic disorders, or other medically complex conditions
* Familiarity with clinical\-trial operations, including participant screening and scheduling, informed\-consent support, source documentation, regulatory files, and electronic data\-capture systems such as REDCap
* Experience coordinating research specimens, including collection, processing, storage, and shipment in accordance with study procedures
* Comfort working in the operating\-room environment in a non\-clinical research\-support role and following infection\-control, privacy, procedural, and safety requirements
* Clinical Research Coordinator certification (e.g., ACRP or SOCRA) or interest in pursuing certification as experience permits
