We're looking for someone early in their career who has some experience working in a fast\-paced creative, agency, entertainment, production, or similar environment and is ready to take the next step.

You don't need to come in knowing everything. We're looking for someone with great organizational instincts, strong attention to detail, and a desire to learn. * Help coordinate the day\-to\-day flow of projects through IAE's Art Department.
* Track project schedules, deadlines, deliverables, revisions, and approvals.
* Help organize incoming creative requests and make sure the team has the information and assets needed to get started.
* Work with the Creative Director to prioritize projects and keep work moving through the department.
* Coordinate communication between the Art Department, Marketing, Booking, and other internal teams.
* Keep project information organized and up to date so teams have visibility into status and next steps.
* Track feedback and revisions and help ensure changes are clearly communicated to the creative team.

jobs.description:
**Operations Coordinator: Logistics, Parts \& Billing**  
Eagle Americas Corporation, Arlington Heights, IL (Hybrid)

**About Us**

Eagle Americas Corporation (EAC) is the U.S. subsidiary of Eagle, a Poland\-based manufacturer of high\-performance industrial fiber laser cutting systems. EAC sells, installs, services, and supports Eagle machines for fabricators across the United States. We're a growing, hands\-on team, and this role sits at the center of how machines, parts, and paperwork move through the business.

**The Role**

We're looking for an Operations Coordinator to handle the day\-to\-day flow of our business: getting machines and spare parts from Europe to our warehouse and customers, keeping parts inventory accurate and stocked, and making sure every service visit, part, and install is invoiced promptly and correctly. You'll report directly to the COO and work closely with our field service technicians, our parent company in Poland, freight carriers, and customs brokers.

**What You'll Do**

*Logistics and Import*

* Coordinate inbound shipments of machines and spare parts from Europe, including freight booking, tracking, and delivery scheduling to our warehouse or directly to customer sites.
* Work with customs brokers to manage import documentation, including commercial invoices, bills of lading, and customs declarations, and keep tariff classifications accurate.
* Compare freight carriers and rates, and manage domestic shipping of parts to customers and field technicians.

*Spare Parts Management*

* Maintain spare parts inventory, including receiving, stocking, cycle counts, and reconciliation between physical stock and our systems.
* Process customer parts orders from quote through shipment and billing.

*Customer Invoicing and Billing*

* Invoice customers for service visits, parts, and installation work, using technician hours, travel, and expense records to build accurate invoices.
* Keep the chain from estimate to sales order to invoice clean in QuickBooks Online, and track open invoices through collection.
* Work down any billing backlog and keep completed work from sitting unbilled.

*Coordination*

* Support scheduling of installations, commissioning, and service visits with the field team, and keep service records current in our systems.
* Serve as a reliable point of contact for customers on order, shipment, and billing questions.

**What We're Looking For**

*Required*

* 3\+ years in logistics, import/export, parts or inventory management, or operations coordination, ideally for capital equipment or industrial machinery.
* Hands\-on experience with import documentation and working with customs brokers.
* Experience invoicing customers and managing billing or accounts receivable.
* Proficiency with accounting, ERP, or inventory systems, and strong Excel skills.
* Highly organized, detail\-oriented, and comfortable handling many moving pieces at once in a small\-company environment.
* Clear, professional communication with customers, vendors, and international colleagues.

*Preferred*

* QuickBooks Online experience.
* Background with industrial machinery, machine tools, or laser cutting equipment.
* Experience with Jira or similar ticketing and service\-tracking tools.

**Work Location**

Hybrid, based at our Arlington Heights, IL office, with regular warehouse visits for receiving and inventory work.

Pay: $45,000\.00 \- $75,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Health savings account
* Paid time off
* Retirement plan
* Vision insurance

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Arlington Heights, IL 60005

**Location(s):** Hybrid work arrangement \- working at our stunning Amara Club and HuddleUp powered by 25N Coworking in Schaumburg, IL and remotely from your home office.


**The Role in a Nutshell:** The Marketing Coordinator will execute fresh and on\-brand ways to tell the story of 25N to the public, casting a vision for what it's like to belong to the 25N community. They strategize and implement digital and print marketing initiatives with the support of the Marketing Manager. They are a strong wordsmith who's a pro at replicating and finding fresh takes on a brand voice in their communication efforts, and have enough technical know\-how to learn new techniques and automate marketing initiatives when needed. **Who you are:** Your working style is the perfect combination of artist, industrious, and operationally\-minded. * Collaborate with the community teams on upcoming events and marketing needs.

The Associate Account Manager, Enterprise works alongside Enterprise Partner Managers (EPMs) to support Grubhub’s Enterprise restaurant brands. As part of a shared account team, you will own key day\-to\-day workstreams across operations, promotions, advertising, and client optimization, while the EPM leads the broader brand strategy and commercial relationship. You will play an important role in helping clients get the most value from their programs through strong execution, performance reporting, and ongoing optimization.

  

You will be an active, client\-facing partner, participating in recurring calls, business reviews/strategic meetings and leading portions of those conversations related to your areas of ownership. A key part of the role is turning client needs into action by triaging requests, coordinating across internal teams, and driving issues through resolution.

### **The Impact You Will Make**

  

* Partner with EPMs to support the day\-to\-day success of Enterprise restaurant brands
* Serve as an active client\-facing partner through recurring calls, QBRs, strategic meetings, and in\-market engagements
* Analyze data to prepare and present updates related to your areas of ownership, including (but not limited to) promotions, advertising, and operational performance
* Own execution, monitoring, optimization, and reporting for promotional and advertising campaigns
* Partner with brands/locations to manage operational workstreams including pauses, cancellations, logistics\-related issues, and account maintenance
* Triage client requests and own cross\-functional issues through resolution, ensuring clear ownership, follow\-up, and communication
* Analyze data to identify operational trends, risks, and opportunities and surface relevant insights to the EPM and client
* Maintain accurate account information and activity within Salesforce and other internal systems
* Support the launch and adoption of new products, programs, and initiatives
* Support the EPM in executing growth strategies by helping clients activate, optimize, and measure relevant products, promotions, and advertising programs
* Participate in onsite client meetings, QBRs, conferences, and other in\-market engagements; some travel required

### **What You Bring to the Table**

  

* Bachelor’s Degree preferred
* 1–2 years of Account Management, Sales, Customer Success, or experience working with large, enterprise clients
* Strong organizational and project management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and drive work through completion
* Strong verbal and written communication skills and confidence working directly with and presenting to enterprise clients
* Strong problem\-solving skills with the ability to assess needs, identify root causes, story tell through data, and coordinate solutions
* Ability to work independently and cross\-functionally to influence and make recommendations to clients
* Strong computer skills, including MS Office and Google products; Salesforce.com or similar CRM experience and JIRA a plus
* Positive, solutions\-oriented approach and comfort working in a fast\-paced, evolving environment
* Experience working with or supporting restaurant partners a plus

  

Our hybrid model requires 3 days a week in the office. That said, many team members choose to come in more often to take advantage of in\-person collaboration and connection. You're welcome—and encouraged—to be in the office up to 5 days a week if it works for you.

Illinois: $44,800\- $56,000 ( $56,000\- $70,000 OTE)

  

Wonder uses geographic\-specific salary structures, which means the salary offered may vary depending on where the job is located. The final salary offer will take into account various factors, such as the candidate's skills, education, training, credentials, and experience.

 **Benefits**

  

The benefits applicable to this role include a competitive compensation package with equity and a 401(k). We also offer a choice of medical, dental, and vision plans, company paid short and long term disability coverage, paid time off including flexible time off for exempt employees, paid vacation for non\-exempt employees, and paid sick leave in compliance with applicable law in addition to paid parental leave, discounted meals and exclusive perks across the Wonder family of brands.

  

Eligibility, effective dates, and available plan options vary by employment classification and location. To learn more about benefits for this role, visit our Careers page here.

At Wonder, we build the best teams by hiring with an objective lens — evaluating people for their potential while championing diversity, equity, and inclusion. jobs.title: Email Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
**Job Description Summary**
===========================


The Email Marketing Manager owns the design, build, deployment, and optimization of the USCAN email channel. Serves as the region’s email subject matter expert, advising marketing and sales on audience, cadence, content, and testing strategies and translating those plans into live, measurable programs in Marketo.**Job Description**
===================

**Roles and Responsibilities**

* **Own the USCAN always\-on email portfolio.** Build, maintain, monitor, and optimize the region’s recurring, trigger\-based email programs, including recycled leads, abandoned cart, welcome series, etc. Ensure each program operates reliably, trigger logic remains accurate, and performance insights are surfaced proactively.
* **Strategize, develop, and optimize email tactics** to find, acquire, nurture, convert, and retain prospects. Integrate the insights to refine segmentation and advance personalization and performance.
* **Build and deploy programs in Marketo.** Construct programs, smart campaigns, triggers, smart lists, and static lists. Maintain campaign naming conventions and UTM tracking to preserve reporting and attribution.
* **Advise, don't just execute.** Serve as the email consultant for internal stakeholders across sales and marketing. Speak knowledgeably about cadence, audience definition, content sequencing, subject lines, and related email strategy. Bring historical performance data into campaign planning early so recommendations are incorporated proactively rather than introduced as reactive changes late in the process.
* **Own email governance and program health**. Maintain and enforce email partnership guidelines and the pre\-send checklist. Protect sender reputation and deliverability. Escalate and, when warranted, pause activation because of regulatory or compliance concerns, consent or privacy uncertainty, destination\-domain concerns, broken tracking or attribution, accessibility issues, or unusual unsubscribe and spam\-complaint trends.
* **Design and run experiments.** Write and execute A/B testing briefs with defined hypotheses, single\-variable discipline, fixed testing windows, and stated success criteria. Report results against the approved brief, make clear recommendations for next steps, and keep documented record of what was learned
* **Report on the channel.** Produce quarterly USCAN email performance reports by segment and sub\-business code, measured against program benchmarks for deliverability, open rate, click rate, and unsubscribe rate. Interpret the results and identify content gaps, audience fatigue, and optimization opportunities rather than simply reporting performance changes.
* **Execute event email programs.** Deliver pre\-show, in\-show, and post\-show email sequences for USCAN events and conferences, as well as the operational email communications that accompany webinars, such as confirmations, reminders, and thank\-you emails.
* **Keep the operational foundation accurate**. Maintain lead source, lead source type, campaign type, and Marketo channel taxonomy so email\-sourced leads are routed and reported on accurately. Source and clean operational data feeds and exclude test and internal records before import.
* **Move work through the approval process.** Route email assets through brand, accessibility, and compliance review as required. Manage intake and status in Workfront so requesting teams have visibility into campaign progress.
* **Raise the standard.** Maintain USCAN email best\-practice guidance covering subject line and preheader construction, body copy optimized for skimmers, single\-CTA discipline, visual hierarchy, mobile\-first and responsive design, accessibility and alt text, and the distinction between nurture and drip campaigns.

 **Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree from an accredited university or college, or a high school diploma/GED with at least six years of hands\-on B2B email marketing and marketing automation experience.
* Demonstrated experience building and deploying campaigns directly in Marketo. This is a hands\-on build role; platform administration experience alone does not meet this requirement.
* Demonstrated experience owning always\-on, trigger\-based, or lifecycle email programs, rather than only executing campaign\-by\-campaign ad hoc sends.
* Demonstrated ability to report email performance against benchmarks, translate results into recommendations, and connect those recommendations to commercial outcomes.
* Experience with a template\-based email build tool like Knak.

 **Desired Characteristics**

* Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to document, plan, and execute programs effectively.
* Marketo Business Practitioner certification or above.
* Experience with Workfront or similar project management software
* Working knowledge of email deliverability and sender reputation, including authentication, list hygiene, engagement\-based sending, and complaint thresholds.
* Familiarity with email accessibility standards and mobile\-first, responsive design.
* Experience with a template\-based email build tool like Knak.
* Experience operating in a regulated or medically reviewed content environment, including MLR or Veeva\-type approval workflows.
* Experience with Salesforce and lead source and campaign taxonomy governance across a Marketo–CRM integration.
* Experience partnering with sales development or inside sales teams on email sequences and recycled\-lead programs.
* Comfort operating as the single named owner of a channel, including setting standards, saying no with a clear rationale, and serving as the primary point of contact for email\-related questions.
* Experience in healthcare, medical device, or another regulated B2B industry.

jobs.title: Customer Sales Representative
jobs.description:
Customer Sales Representative

**Naperville, IL \| Full\-Time \| W2**  
**$800–$1,200 Per Week \| Weekly Pay \| Paid Training \| Commission Opportunity**

Good With People? Put That Skill to Work.

Some people are naturally good at talking to others.

They know how to start a conversation, ask the right questions, listen and make complicated choices easier to understand.

If that sounds like you, our client is expanding its customer\-facing sales team in the Naperville, IL market and is hiring a **Customer Sales Representative**.

This is a full\-time position combining **customer service, retail sales, relationship building and account development**.

Previous telecommunications or wireless experience is not required.

**Paid training is provided.**

What You'll Actually Be Doing

This is an active, people\-facing position.

You won't spend your entire day behind a register or sitting at a desk.

Instead, you'll interact directly with customers inside partnered retail locations.

Your responsibilities include:

* Greeting and engaging customers face\-to\-face
* Starting natural, professional conversations with shoppers
* Building rapport and creating a positive customer experience
* Asking questions to understand individual household needs
* Learning about customers' current internet, mobile and connectivity services
* Educating customers on available AT\&T products and services
* Explaining current options, features, pricing and promotions clearly
* Helping customers compare available solutions
* Generating qualified customer interest and sales opportunities
* Recommending services based on individual customer needs
* Answering customer questions
* Guiding interested customers through the enrollment process
* Maintaining accurate customer and account information
* Building relationships throughout the customer experience
* Developing strong working relationships with retail employees and store leadership
* Maintaining current product and promotional knowledge
* Tracking customer interactions and individual sales activity
* Working toward individual and team performance goals
* Participating in ongoing customer service, product and sales training

Great Sales Starts With a Conversation.

We're not looking for someone who can memorize a pitch.

We're looking for someone who can understand a customer.

What are they currently using?

What are they paying for?

How many people and devices are connected in their home?

Are they streaming, gaming or working remotely?

What matters most when they're choosing a service?

You'll learn how to move naturally through:

**Conversation → Discovery → Education → Recommendation → Enrollment**

The goal is to understand first and recommend second.

That's **consultative sales**, and it's a skill that translates far beyond telecommunications.

Compensation$800–$1,200 Per Week

**Weekly Pay \| Full\-Time \| W2 \| Paid Training**

Performance\-based commission opportunities are available.

Actual compensation within the advertised range depends on experience, individual performance and the applicable compensation structure.

Complete compensation details are reviewed during the interview process.

No Telecom Experience? No Problem.

Products can be taught.

We're hiring for the qualities that are harder to teach:

**Communication. Confidence. Reliability. Coachability. Work Ethic.**

You may be a strong fit if you:

* Enjoy meeting and talking with new people
* Can confidently initiate conversations
* Naturally build relationships
* Have strong customer service instincts
* Listen before recommending a solution
* Communicate clearly and professionally
* Enjoy working toward measurable goals
* Are motivated by performance and earning potential
* Take coaching and feedback well
* Are dependable and team\-oriented
* Want opportunities for professional growth
* Are comfortable working in an active retail environment
* Have full\-time availability
* Can work weekends as required by the retail schedule

Your Experience May Be More Relevant Than You Think

You don't need a traditional sales background.

Candidates with experience in the following areas often transition well:

**Customer Service**  Retail **Restaurants**  Serving **Bartending**  Hospitality **Front Desk**  Electronics **Wireless**  Cell Phone Sales **Fitness**  Athletics **Events**  Promotions **Marketing**  Customer Relations **Account Support**  Sales

Recent graduates and entry\-level candidates are encouraged to apply.

Pay: $800\.00 \- $1,200\.00 per week

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid training
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Business Development Representative - Central & West Coast Regions
jobs.description:
**Building the people that build the world.**


With platforms in HVAC and Detection and Measurement, SPX Technologies builds innovative solutions that enable a safer, more efficient, sustainable world. Through our RiSE talent development framework, we Reach, Identify, Strengthen, and Engage our employees to support them in their continued development. We’re a global company of problem solvers, collaborators, and innovators, and our businesses build solutions that impact the world.


As part of Detection and Measurement, Genfare is a leader in configurable fare collection systems in the public transit industry. By creating high quality equipment and payment systems to improve the rider experience, we empower equitable mobility and provide services to better connect communities.

  


**JOB SUMMARY**

  


The Business Development Representative is a front\-line employee of Genfare and works to support the building, delivery and closing of pipeline of opportunities for revenue growth. The role is part sales (hardware and software), consultation (solutions), and account management.


The Business Development Representative is a critical sales generator for our company. This role is active in three main areas while working to meet or exceed a bookings’ quota:


1\. Obtain new business


2\. Expand sales received from existing customers; deepen and broaden relationships; and,


3\. Ensure retention of customers


The role works with small transit agencies (mostly those with 50 buses or fewer) and industry partners in a defined region, and proposes solutions relevant to their needs. Activity includes providing quotes and specifications, performing demos, and acting as the ultimate customer advocate. You are an individual contributor but can’t do everything on your own – you want to work with the larger team so you can understand the product and solutions to best sell to customers.


The role is very customer\-focused so be ready to visit, call, email and meet virtually with your transit agency counterparts. One of your main strengths is listening and building account plans to help map your customers’ goals into actions to meet their needs for today and plan for their future. You can translate those needs with our internal stakeholders to build viable, value\-driven solutions that solve real world problems that can be leveraged for multiple customers.


Reporting to the Regional Sales Director – Central \& West Regions, this role is critical for continued growth at Genfare with an established book of business and customer relationships.

 **PRINCIPLE DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

  

* Contributes to the development and monitoring of the pipeline of sales activity for new business within a designated territory.
* Participates in the development and execution of short\- and long\-range sales plans.
* Responds to customer inquiries related to quote requests, escalations, RFPs, and future\-state needs.
* Supports the RFP and proposal development process by reviewing customer requirements, coordinating internal stakeholders, assisting with proposal content and pricing inputs, and participating in customer presentations and procurement discussions under the guidance of the Business Development Director.
* Works to identify and develop new customer relationships and further penetrate/expand existing customer relationships.
* Collaborates with company leadership to support the execution of the regional sales strategy.
* Visits existing and prospective customers to develop and/or expand client relationships.
* Gathers market intelligence to stay apprised of competitor offerings, pricing, distribution channels, market trends, etc.
* Participates in industry associations and conferences.
* Monitors performance of existing account relationships.
* Assists with special projects (as assigned by management) to support sales initiatives.

 **KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS \& ABILITIES**

  

* Experience working with customers in a sales, account management, business development, and/or customer success role. Ability to develop trusted relationships and effectively communicate customer needs.
* Proven effectiveness in the use of professional sales methodologies and systems.
* An understanding of customer relationship management and cross\-selling techniques.
* Must be able to work effectively in a team environment and possess interpersonal skills necessary to successfully collaborate with others to achieve business goals.
* Ability to quickly analyze rapidly changing circumstances and to provide sound strategic and tactical sales advice.
* Ability to communicate and negotiate effectively, both orally and in writing.
* Ability to make effective presentations to diverse audiences – management and employees – both internally and externally.
* Adaptability and flexibility to manage multiple priorities and work under deadlines.
* Excellent analytical, problem\-solving skills with a methodical approach to problem resolution across large\-scale distributed platforms.
* Effectively build relationships and collaborate with stakeholders and partners.
* Demonstrates strong written, verbal, and interpersonal skills.
* Familiarity with fare collection is desirable.

 **EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE**

  

**Education / Experience**

* Bachelor’s and/or advanced degree in Business, Marketing or a related field.
* Minimum 3 years’ experience in progressive sales/business development with multiple services or product lines, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Exposure to multiple, diverse technologies and processing environments.
* Professional sales and/or marketing management experience demonstrating a track record of success in building and growing a business will be considered from a variety of industries.
* Must be extremely resourceful, willing to step in where necessary and be motivated to create new resources to aid the sales cycle.
* Effective, clear, and concise communication skills.
* Proficiency with Sale

jobs.title: Client Success Executive
jobs.description:
**Who we are**



Founded in 1999 and headquartered in Central Ohio, we’re a privately\-owned, independent healthcare navigation organization. We believe that no one should have to navigate the cost and complexity of healthcare alone, and we’re on a mission to make healthcare simpler and more effective for our millions of members. Our big\-hearted, tech\-savvy team fights to ensure that our members get the care they need, when they need it, at the most affordable cost – that’s why we call ourselves Healthcare Warriors®.



We’re committed to building diverse and inclusive teams – more than 2,000 of us and counting – so if you’re excited about this position, we encourage you to apply – even if your experience doesn’t match every requirement.

  

The Client Success Executive (CSE) is responsible for ensuring clients achieve maximum value from the company's products or services, fostering long\-term client satisfaction, and driving client retention and growth. The CSE works closely with clients to understand their goals, ensure effective adoption, and identify opportunities for account expansion and business growth. This role involves day\-to\-day client management, proactive engagement to address client needs, and collaborating cross\-functionally to drive success outcomes.



The ideal candidate will have a background in mid\-scale customer relationship management with demonstrated success exceeding expectations maintaining and growing their book.



What you’ll do


* Client Value Realization: Work closely with clients to understand their business objectives and ensure the company’s product or service delivers measurable value aligned with their goals.
* Client Relationship Management: Serve as the primary point of contact for key accounts, managing day\-to\-day communications and ensuring strong relationships with client stakeholders at all levels.
* Onboarding \& Adoption: Lead clients through the onboarding process and drive product/service adoption by providing training, best practices, and ongoing support tailored to their specific needs.
* Client Growth \& Upselling: Identify opportunities for account growth, including upselling additional services, cross\-selling complementary products, and recommending new solutions that enhance client success and increase revenue.
* Retention \& Renewal Management: Proactively manage client renewals, minimizing churn through ongoing engagement and demonstrating continuous value.
* Client Health Monitoring: Regularly track and assess client health, using data and insights to identify risks and opportunities for deeper engagement and growth.
* Strategic Account Planning: Develop and execute client success plans that align with client goals and foster long\-term partnerships, driving retention and growth within assigned accounts.
* Performance Metrics \& Reporting: Monitor key success metrics such as adoption rates, client satisfaction scores (NPS/CSAT), and revenue growth. Regularly report progress and outcomes to both clients and internal stakeholders.
* Issue Resolution: Act as a trusted advisor and advocate for the client, ensuring any issues or concerns are addressed swiftly and effectively, coordinating with internal teams as necessary.
* Cross\-functional Collaboration: Work closely with Sales, Product, Marketing, and Support teams to ensure a seamless client experience and identify opportunities for improvement or innovation in the client journey.
* Client Feedback \& Product Improvement: Collect and relay client feedback to internal teams, providing insights to improve product offerings, services, and overall client experience.
* Other duties as assigned


What you’ll bring


* Education: Bachelor's degree in business or equivalent experience.
* Experience: 5 \- 7\+ years' related industry experience in consulting, sales, or other applicable area.
* Proven experience in client success, account management, or customer experience, with a focus on driving client outcomes and revenue growth.
* Strong relationship\-building and communication skills, capable of working with a variety of client stakeholders, including executives.
* Experience in managing complex client accounts and coordinating across multiple departments.
* A results\-driven mindset, with a focus on client retention, growth, and overall satisfaction.
* Proficiency with CRM systems and client success platforms.
* Analytical thinking and problem\-solving skills to proactively address client challenges.
* Travel required as needed – cyclical depending on client needs.
* Protect and take care of our company and member’s data every day by committing to work within our company ethics and policies.


**What’s in it for you:**


* **Compensation:** Competitive base and incentive compensation
* **Coverage:** Health, vision and dental featuring our best\-in\-class healthcare navigation services, along with life insurance, legal and identity protection, adoption assistance, EAP, Teladoc services and more.
* **Retirement:** 401(k) plan with up to 4% employer match and full vesting on day one.
* **Balance:** Paid Time Off (PTO), 7 paid holidays, parental leave, volunteer days, paid sabbaticals, and more.
* **Development:** Tuition reimbursement up to $5,250 annually, certification/continuing education reimbursement, discounted higher education partnerships, paid trainings and leadership development.
* **Culture:** Recognition as a Best Place to Work for 15\+ years, dedication to diversity, philanthropy and sustainability, and people\-first values that drive every decision.
* **Environment:** A modern workplace with a casual dress code, open floor plans, full\-service dining, free snacks and drinks, complimentary 24/7 fitness center with group classes, outdoor walking paths, game room, notary and dry\-cleaning services and more!

* **Internal Associates:** Already a Healthcare Warrior? Apply internally through Lever

**About Human Capital Education**

Human Capital Education (HCE) enables colleges and universities to grow with purpose by providing the systems, expertise, data, and strategy needed to attract, enroll, and support students more effectively and efficiently. HCE works across undergraduate, graduate, online, and adult programs, helping institutions translate strategy into actionable insights that deliver sustainable results.


In January 2026, Human Capital Education acquired Kennedy \& Company Education Strategies, bringing together complementary organizations with a shared commitment to helping institutions navigate change, strengthen performance, and achieve long\-term sustainability. Human Capital Education seeks a proactive, highly dependable Executive Assistant to serve as a trusted operational partner to the EOA team and Managing Directors. The role combines executive support, client coordination, deliverable development, business operations, and project follow\-through.


The Executive Assistant creates capacity for senior leaders by anticipating needs, strengthening client relationships, coordinating high\-quality work products, and supporting sound operational decisions. Although the role includes calendar and travel coordination, its primary purpose is to help the EOA team operate effectively and deliver exceptional client service.

new_jobs.title: Account Manager, West Coast
new_jobs.description:
**Hy\-Tek Intralogistics**
**Job Description**
**Job Title:** Account Executive
**Department:** System Sales
**Supervisor:** SVP, System Sales  

**Job Purpose:**
Contact existing or potential customers to promote new sales of material handling equipment and systems. Handle all sales development for specified products within the assigned territory – customer base. This includes the handling of customer concerns and complaints.  


**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**
* Develop and maintain annual sales plan. Present sales plan to supervisor and manage daily efforts toward plan.
* Manage and grow relationships with current customers. Regularly visit customer sites to understand customers operations; identify opportunities where the company can add value; introduce products, services, and solutions.
* Respond to all inquiries from users and suppliers.
* Develop new customer relationships by identifying business needs and growth plans, educating key decision makers, and recommending integrated solutions to achieve business goals.
* Anticipate customer needs and proactively customize solutions to meet customer’s business objectives. Inform customers of material handling technology trends.
* Work on multiple projects simultaneously, often with assistance from engineering and project management, but regularly complete small to mid\-sized projects independently. Collect data that accurately represents customer requirements. Develop concepts that range from manual to fully automated solutions.
* Develop proposals that include technical and functional descriptions. Present proposals to clients.
* Follow up on all proposals, negotiate, and close. Be certain that any changes or revisions regardless of the origins are well documented.
* Upon acceptance, process the order internally by transitioning the project to the engineering group and project management team. Introduce the project management team to the customer. Although the project management team will inform the customer of project status from installation to completion, start\-up and final payment, you should remain engaged through the process as needed.
* Work with our post project support team to offer customers after sales service and preventive maintenance plans.
* Utilize a Customer Relationship Management (CRM) tool to track the sales cycle.

  


**Knowledge, Skills and Abilities Preferred:**
* Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration or related degree is preferred
* 3 \- 5 years of experience in a technical or industrial sales role. Material handling systems experience and/or distribution operations experience would be a plus.
* Maintain accurate account development records and keep sales management informed of the status of each open project or recent sales proposal.
* Maintain a high degree of communication about customer proposals with engineering and sales support staff.
* Prepare equipment operational descriptions if required for specific projects.
* Experience in industrial capital equipment sales, selling six to seven figure solutions to Executives and Committees
* Great interpersonal skills – Displays honesty, ethics, and integrity at all times.
* Provide effective oral and written communications to customers, company management and co\-workers.
* Ability to organize a selling plan and exhibit time management skills
* Competency in time and account management
* Strong skills in prospecting, active listening, questioning, uncovering problems or client objectives, uncovering budget, understanding the prospect’s decision\-making process, proposal development and presentation, account retention, verbal\-telephone and written communication.
* Ability to read and understand building drawing, technical layouts, and equipment specifications. Proficiency with ACAD is a plus.

  


**Working Conditions:**
* Ability to travel up to 50% or as needed with fluctuation in intensity based on the phase of the project.
* Willingness to work extended hours to support proposal and contract activities.
* Working in office, warehouse, and manufacturing facilities.
* Working in a stationary position for an extended period.
* Moving or traversing for an extended period.
* Occasional ascending and descending scaffolding and/or mezzanines.
* Operating computers for an extended period.
* Possible exposure to noise levels exceeding recommended DBA levels.
* Occasional movement and positioning of objects weighing up to 75 pounds.

  


*\*\*\*Job requirements listed indicate the minimum level of knowledge, skills, and/or ability necessary to perform the job proficiently. This job description is not an exhaustive statement of duties, responsibilities, or requirements. Employees may be required to perform other job\-related duties as requested by their supervisor, subject to reasonable accommodations. \*\*\**

new_jobs.title: Partnerships Operations Specialist
new_jobs.description:
Snap Inc is a technology company. We believe the camera presents the greatest opportunity to improve the way people live and communicate. Snap contributes to human progress by empowering people to express themselves, live in the moment, learn about the world, and have fun together.

  

  

The Company operates Snapchat , a visual messaging app that enhances your relationships with friends, family, and the world, and Specs Inc. , a wholly\-owned subsidiary dedicated to making computing more human, in addition to Bitmoji , Saturn, and other digital services.

  

  

We’re looking for a Partnerships Operations Specialist to join the Partnerships Operations team at Snap.

  

  

The person in this role will work across scaled support and education, creator program execution, budget operations, events, and team operations. They will independently own defined workflows and operational workstreams, coordinate closely with cross\-functional partners, and turn priorities into clear plans, accurate tracking, and dependable follow\-through. They will also work with Partnerships and cross\-functional verticals to identify efficiencies and build and implement processes that improve how the organization operates.

  

  

This is a strong fit for someone who is highly organized, detail\-oriented, and excited to operate in a fast\-paced, cross\-functional environment. The ideal candidate is comfortable managing multiple workstreams at once, can learn complex products and processes quickly, communicate clearly with internal and external stakeholders, and can identify opportunities to make our work more efficient and scalable.

  

  

What You’ll Do:

  

  

Scaled Support \& Operations


* Support technical and operational programs for creators and content partners, coordinating issue escalations, surfacing user feedback, and partnering with Product, Engineering, and other teams to drive resolution and improvements.
* Manage execution for programs, pilots, and new initiatives, coordinating timelines, participation, deliverables, payments, and cross\-functional dependencies.
* Maintain the processes, documentation, and resources that enable consistent, high\-quality support at scale.
* Identify recurring issues and operational gaps, translating them into opportunities to improve workflows, tools, and the overall partner experience.
  

  

Education \& Communications


* Support onboarding and education through lifecycle communications, product and program updates, newsletters, and educational resources.
* Partner cross\-functionally to translate product, program, and policy changes into clear, actionable guidance for external partners and internal teams.
* Help evolve scaled education programs and channels to improve awareness and adoption of Snapchat products, features, and programs.
  

  

Partnerships \& Team Operations


* Support key team operating rhythms and initiatives, including quarterly planning and Partnerships events.
* Manage budget and payment operations, including spend tracking, purchase orders, vendor onboarding, and creator and partner payments.
* Maintain clear processes, trackers, and documentation that provide visibility into priorities, ownership, and progress across the Partnerships organization.
* Identify opportunities to simplify, automate, and improve recurring workflows, partnering with technical and operational teams on tools and AI\-enabled solutions where appropriate.
  

  

Knowledge, Skills \& Abilities


* Strong organizational and project coordination skills, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams, deadlines, and stakeholders at the same time.
* High attention to detail and operational rigor, especially when managing payments, approvals, communications, event logistics, and program deliverables.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to turn complex product or program information into clear, actionable guidance.
* Demonstrated ability to independently manage defined operational workflows and cross\-functional workstreams from planning through completion.
* Comfort working with spreadsheets, trackers, documentation, CRM systems, and project\-management tools.
* Ability to learn new products, systems, and processes quickly and apply that knowledge to support creators, partners, and internal stakeholders.
* Interest in process improvement, automation, and using data or emerging tools to make recurring work more efficient.

At Zimmer Biomet, we believe in pushing the boundaries of innovation and driving our mission forward. As a global medical technology leader for nearly 100 years, a patient’s mobility is enhanced by a Zimmer Biomet product or technology every 8 seconds.


As a Zimmer Biomet team member, you will share in our commitment to providing mobility and renewed life to people around the world. To support our talent team, we focus on development opportunities, robust employee resource groups (ERGs), a flexible working environment, location specific competitive total rewards, wellness incentives and a culture of recognition and performance awards. We are committed to creating an environment where every team member feels included, respected, empowered and recognised.

**What You Can Expect**
-----------------------


Responsible for attaining sales goals and objectives through the creation and execution of a sales plan in the assigned area. This position will drive sales growth through communication and in\-person interactions with current and prospective customers regarding Zimmer Biomet products. This position may mentor/lead other less experienced sales team members.**How You'll Create Impact**
----------------------------


* + Builds strong relationships with key surgeons in the given area, while able to cover orthopedic procedures with clinical proficiency and business acumen.
	+ Builds and implements a sales plan for the assigned area, manages and tracks customer sales activity and prospective customer initiatives, achieves sales targets, reports on sales progress and competitor and customer activities to sales leader, and utilizes the s

	+ Provides after hour and/or evening case coverage and add on case coverage for team and/or territory. Includes weekend and on\-call case coverage and add on case coverage for team and/or territory.

* Demonstrated ability to communicate with and influence others
* Willing and capable of carrying weights up to 50 pounds, independently.

* Up to 95% predominantly by car, depending on territory.Up to 20% overnight travel may be required.

new_jobs.description:
### **Description**

  

Astrana Health is seeking a Business Development Representative \- ACO Growth to drive top\-of\-funnel growth and new partner acquisition for the organization’s Accountable Care Organization (ACO) initiatives. This role focuses on outbound prospecting, lead generation, and meeting development with physician groups, independent practices, and healthcare organizations interested in participating in value\-based care and ACO programs.  

  

Reporting to the Senior Director of ACO Growth, this BDR plays a critical role in building the  

organization’s ACO pipeline by identifying qualified opportunities, initiating conversations with prospective partners, and supporting the sales process through follow\-up, relationship nurturing,  

and meeting coordination. As the role ramps and performance milestones are achieved, the BDR  

may also lead select smaller opportunities through the closing process, supporting expansion of  

the ACO network and physician participation. This position requires a high\-energy,  

entrepreneurial sales mindset, strong communication skills, and a genuine interest in healthcare transformation and value\-based care.  

  

We are seeking candidates who are located in Southern California. Travel to physician practices across the West Coast will be required for this role.  

  

Our Values:  

* *Patients First*
* *Empowering the Independent Provider*
* *Be Innovative*
* *Operate with Integrity \& Deliver Excellence*
* *Team of One*
  

### **What You'll Do**

  

* Analyze market dynamics, provider landscapes, and competitive positioning to identify high\-value partnership opportunities
* Evaluate prospective providers based on strategic fit, growth potential, and alignment with value\-based care objectives
* Prioritize outreach and engagement efforts based on market needs, organizational goals, and potential return on investment
* Provide recommendations to leadership on target markets, provider segments, and outreach strategies
* Develop and execute targeted outreach strategies for engaging physician groups, practices, and healthcare organizations
* Lead initial engagement discussions with prospective partners, presenting value\-based care offerings and partnership opportunities
* Tailor messaging and engagement approaches based on provider type, size, and market conditions
* Build and maintain relationships with key stakeholders to advance partnership discussions
* Own and manage a pipeline of prospective ACO partners, ensuring alignment with strategic growth priorities
* Exercise judgment in advancing, pausing, or deprioritizing opportunities based on evolving business needs
* Lead follow\-up strategies and engagement plans to move opportunities through the pipeline
* As appropriate, independently manage lower\-complexity opportunities through later stages of the sales cycle
* Partner with internal stakeholders including Network Management, Operations, and Clinical teams to align partnership strategies
* Provide input into proposal development, partnership structuring, and engagement approaches
* Influence internal decision\-making by providing insights on provider needs, market trends, and competitive dynamics
* Analyze outreach effectiveness, pipeline conversion trends, and engagement outcomes to refine strategies
* Identify opportunities to improve messaging, targeting, and engagement tactics
* Provide data\-driven insights and recommendations to leadership to enhance ACO growth performance
* Conduct in\-person meetings, site visits, and presentations with prospective provider partners
* Represent the organization at industry events, conferences, and networking opportunities
* Serve as a market\-facing representative to support brand awareness and relationship development
* Other duties as assigned

  

### **Qualifications**

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Healthcare Administration, Marketing, or related field
* 2\+ years of experience in sales development, business development, or inside sales
* Strong prospecting, outreach, and relationship\-building skills
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Ability to manage high volumes of outreach activity and maintain strong organization
* Proficiency with CRM tools and Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook)
* **Orange County resident preferred**
* **Bilingual Vietnamese preferred**

You're great for this role if you have:* Experience in healthcare, physician practice sales, managed care, or value\-based care
* Knowledge of ACO models, population health, or healthcare payment reform
* Experience with outbound prospecting tools such as Salesforce, HubSpot, Outreach, or  

 similar platforms
* Strong sales prospecting and lead generation capability
* Ability to build rapport quickly with physicians and healthcare leaders
* Highly motivated with a results\-driven mindset
* Strong follow\-through and attention to detail
* Comfortable operating in a fast\-paced startup\-style growth environment
* Ability to work independently while collaborating with senior leadership

### **Environmental Job Requirements and Working Conditions**

  

* This is a full\-time position. Working across time zones will be required per business need.
* This is a hybrid position, where you will be working remote with required travel across the US, predominantly across California/West Coast. Travel is expected up to 30% for the first year, however, we are seeking candidates who are interested in growing into a larger\-capacity role after year 1 with more frequent travel.
* The national target compensation for this position is $80,000 \- $120,000 annually, between base salary and bonus structure. Compensation will be comprised of a base salary between $80,000 \- $93,000 per year, as well as a performance\-based bonus structure. Actual compensation will be determined based on geographic location (current or future), experience, and other job\-related factors.

Additionally, the Executive Assistant manages oversight of building maintenance and vendor coordination, ensuring the facility operates efficiently and complies with safety standards. Manage, write, and track all Reconditioning, PDI, and Inventory Recall’s. .

**What are the day\-to\-day responsibilities?**

* Manage the Reconditioning Vendor relationships, to improve quality, cycle time and accurate timely invoices.

* Adhere to all company policies, procedures and safety standards.

* Must meet company’s requirements for employment.
* Valid in\-state driver’s license and have and maintain an acceptable, safe driving record.
* Ability to drive manual transmission vehicles.
* Professional appearance.
* Demonstrated customer service skills.
* Previous industry knowledge preferred.
* High school diploma or the equivalent.
* Ability to read and comprehend written instructions and information.
* Production related experience preferred.
* ASE certification preferred.
* Excellent written, oral and interpersonal communication skills.

* Exposure to inclement weather.
* Ability to operate an automobile.
* Prolonged periods of standing, stooping and bending.

* Competitive compensation and 401k matching
* Enjoy a healthy work\-life balance with insurance plans (health, dental, vision) and maternity benefits.
* Associate purchase and discount programs for new and pre\-owned vehicles, services, parts, collision, accessories, and AutoGear

new_jobs.title: Employee Benefits Account Manager
new_jobs.description:
**Foundation Risk Partners****, one of the fastest growing insurance brokerage and consulting firms in the US, is adding an Employee Benefits Account Manager to their team in Orange, CA.**


**Job Summary:**



The Employee Benefits Account Manager is responsible for supporting the growth, retention, and servicing of employee benefits clients through proactive relationship management, exceptional customer service, and collaboration with producers, carrier partners, and internal teams. This client\-facing role serves as a trusted resource to clients while supporting sales initiatives, renewal strategies, benefit program implementation, and ongoing account management activities.


**Essential Functions:**


* Retain and grow an assigned book of business by delivering exceptional service and supporting client satisfaction initiatives.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, prospects, carrier partners, and internal stakeholders.
* Serve as a primary client contact, responding to inquiries and providing day\-to\-day account support.
* Support sales and business development efforts through prospect meetings, proposal preparation, cross\-selling opportunities, and onboarding activities.
* Coordinate and manage renewal activities, including gathering data, reviewing plan options, evaluating carrier proposals, and preparing client recommendations.
* Assist clients with benefit plan changes, employee communications, open enrollment support, and implementation activities.
* Educate clients regarding industry trends, legislative updates, compliance considerations, market conditions, and available insurance solutions.
* Develop and maintain service plans that align with client objectives and support long\-term retention.
* Partner with carrier representatives and internal teams to address service concerns, claims issues, enrollment challenges, and escalated client matters.
* Prepare stewardship reports, presentations, renewal reviews, and client\-facing materials.
* Ensure accurate documentation and maintenance of account information within agency systems.
* Maintain compliance with agency procedures, carrier requirements, and applicable federal and California regulations.
* Participate in team meetings, training initiatives, and professional development opportunities.
* Perform additional duties and special projects as assigned.


**Competencies \& Qualifications:**


* Minimum of 5 years of employee benefits account management experience.
* Active California Life, Accident \& Health Insurance License in good standing.
* Professional designation such as CEBS, RHU, REBC, GBA, or other industry\-related certification preferred.
* Strong knowledge of employee benefits products, including medical, dental, vision, life, disability, and voluntary benefits.
* Strong understanding of employee benefits compliance requirements and group\-size regulations including applicable state and federal laws.
* Experience supporting employee benefits sales, account management, renewals, and client service functions.
* Excellent relationship\-building and customer service skills.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to present information professionally to clients and prospects.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, including Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
* Prior experience with Epic, Sales Force, Ease, Employee Navigator and Wood \& Brown is preferred.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining attention to detail and meeting deadlines.
* Knowledge of employee benefits regulations and compliance requirements.

new_jobs.title: Commercial Plumbing Business Account Manager
new_jobs.description:
**VeriTech Plumbing** **is a** **commercial plumbing services company** **built to serve** **professional operators, property managers, and facilities teams** **who demand reliability, documentation, and long\-term partnership—not one\-off service calls.**
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


We work across **multifamily portfolios, commercial real estate, industrial facilities, and multi\-location businesses,** including restaurant and retail chains. As VeriTech continues to scale across Southern California and beyond, we are building a **dedicated commercial business development team** to support that growth.


This role is designed for someone who wants to **build a career**, not just hit a short\-term commission number.

**About the Role**
------------------


This is a **field\-driven, relationship\-first position** focused on creating **long\-term commercial accounts** that stay with VeriTech for years.


You will act as the **front door to the company**—introducing VeriTech to new portfolios, educating decision\-makers on our capabilities, and building trust that turns into recurring service relationships.


Unlike residential sales roles, this position is about **account ownership, retention, and growth**, not one\-time transactions.

**What You’ll Be Doing**
------------------------

* Build and manage a pipeline of **commercial, multifamily, industrial, and B2B accounts**
* Spend the majority of your time **in the field**, meeting:


	+ Property \& asset managers
	+ Facilities and maintenance leaders
	+ HOA management companies and boards
	+ Regional operators for restaurant \& retail groups
	+ Commercial and industrial site leadership
* Develop relationships within industry organizations such as:


	+ **Institute of Real Estate Management (IREM)**
	+ **Building Owners and Managers Association (BOMA)**
	+ **California Apartment Association (CAA)**
	+ **International Facility Management Association (IFMA)**
* Introduce VeriTech as a **preferred plumbing partner**, not just a vendor
* Schedule site walks, capability meetings, and portfolio reviews
* Attend **industry events, association meetings, and networking functions**
* Work closely with operations to ensure smooth onboarding of new accounts
* Maintain accurate CRM records and follow\-up plans
* Use LinkedIn and direct outreach to identify and pursue strategic accounts

**How Success Is Measured**
---------------------------

* Quality and durability of accounts brought on (not just volume)
* Growth of recurring revenue within your portfolio
* Retention and expansion of existing relationships
* Professional representation of the VeriTech brand in the field

**Compensation \& Benefits**
----------------------------

**Incentives:**

* Commission tied to **long\-term recurring revenue**, not one\-off jobs
* Monthly and quarterly performance bonuses
* Clear upside as accounts grow over time

**Benefits:**

* Medical, dental, and vision coverage
* 401(k) with company match
* Paid holidays \& PTO
* Mileage reimbursement or vehicle allowance
* Paid industry memberships and networking events
* Trade shows, conferences, and professional development covered
* Company apparel and branded materials

**Who This Role Is For**
------------------------

* Someone with **B2B or commercial sales experience** who wants stability and growth
* A relationship builder who enjoys **face\-to\-face interaction**
* A self\-starter comfortable managing their own territory and schedule
* Someone interested in **owning a book of business** over the long term
* A professional who wants to grow into leadership as the company scales

**Plumbing or trades experience is not required.** We train the technical side. We’re hiring for mindset, professionalism, and relationship\-building ability.

**Long\-Term Career Path at VeriTech**
--------------------------------------


This role is intentionally built as a **growth position**:

* **Business Development Representative**  


	+ Own and grow a portfolio of commercial accounts
* **Senior Business Development Manager**  


	+ Manage larger portfolios, key accounts, and strategic relationships
* **Business Development Director / Regional Manager**  


	+ Help lead market expansion, mentor reps, and shape company growth


As VeriTech expands into new markets and verticals, top performers will have **real advancement opportunities**, not capped roles.

**Why VeriTech Plumbing?**
--------------------------

* Commercial\-only focus — no residential churn
* Strong demand from professional property and facilities operators
* Long\-term account relationships, not transactional selling
* The leadership team focused on **scaling a platform**, not just running jobs
* Opportunity to grow alongside the company

new_jobs.title: Assistant Clinical Research Coordinator - Neurological Surgery
new_jobs.description:
Under the supervision of the Principal Investigators, Clinical Research Manager, and Senior Study Coordinators, the Assistant Clinical Research Coordinator supports the day\-to\-day coordination of the Pediatric Epilepsy Center of Excellence clinical research portfolio. The position supports industry\-sponsored and investigator\-initiated clinical trials, including gene therapy, antisense oligonucleotide, and small\-molecule studies, as well as prospective observational and longitudinal natural\-history studies. This is a hybrid role requiring a minimum of three days on site at the UCSF Mission Bay Campus each week.


Working closely with senior coordinators, investigators, clinical teams, sponsors, and coordinating centers, the incumbent supports recruitment and retention, research visits, informed\-consent preparation under investigator direction, data and regulatory documentation, research specimens, monitoring visits, and study start\-up and closeout activities. The role is family\-centered, conducted under close supervision initially, with increasing independence with demonstrated competency.


The research population includes infants, children, and adolescents with complex neurologic disorders, including epilepsy. The incumbent must be comfortable engaging warmly and professionally with children of all ages, including newborns and young infants, and with their parents and caregivers. This role requires sensitivity to the demands placed on families managing medically complex conditions, excellent communication skills, and an ability to make research visits organized and family\-centered.


  
Required Qualifications:


* High School Diploma; or equivalent experience
* Demonstrated ability to organize competing priorities, maintain accurate records, and manage detail\-oriented work reliably and on time
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate respectfully and effectively with children, parents, caregivers, and multidisciplinary clinical and research teams
* Proficiency with standard office and data\-entry applications and the ability to learn study databases, electronic health record systems, and other research tools
* Ability to work collaboratively in a fast\-paced pediatric clinical environment, exercise sound judgment, maintain confidentiality, and follow approved protocols and institutional procedures
* Willingness to complete required training in human\-subjects protection, Good Clinical Practice, privacy, and study\-specific procedures
* For studies involving investigational drug delivery or other study\-related procedures in the operating room, the incumbent may assist with non\-clinical research coordination before, during, and after the procedure. The coordinator must be comfortable working in the operating\-room environment and adhering to all applicable infection\-control, privacy, procedural, and safety requirements. Duties may include confirming study documentation, coordinating research samples or study materials, communicating with the procedural and clinical teams, and documenting protocol\-required activities. The incumbent will not perform clinical or sterile\-field duties unless separately qualified, credentialed, and authorized to do so
  

Preferred Qualifications:


* BS Degree in related science
* Prior experience in clinical research, research coordination, or a health\-care setting, particularly within an academic medical center
* Experience working with pediatric patients and families, especially those affected by epilepsy, neurologic disorders, or other medically complex conditions
* Familiarity with clinical\-trial operations, including participant screening and scheduling, informed\-consent support, source documentation, regulatory files, and electronic data\-capture systems such as REDCap
* Experience coordinating research specimens, including collection, processing, storage, and shipment in accordance with study procedures
* Comfort working in the operating\-room environment in a non\-clinical research\-support role and following infection\-control, privacy, procedural, and safety requirements
* Clinical Research Coordinator certification (e.g., ACRP or SOCRA) or interest in pursuing certification as experience permits

  
**About UCSF**  

The University of California, San Francisco (UCSF) is a leading university dedicated to promoting health worldwide through advanced biomedical research, graduate\-level education in the life sciences and health professions, and excellence in patient care. It is the only campus in the 10\-campus UC system dedicated exclusively to the health sciences. We bring together the world’s leading experts in nearly every area of health. We are home to five Nobel laureates who have advanced the understanding of cancer, neurodegenerative diseases, aging and stem cells.  

  

**Pride Values**  

UCSF is a diverse community made of people with many skills and talents. We seek candidates whose work experience or community service has prepared them to contribute to our commitment to professionalism, respect, integrity, diversity and excellence – also known as our PRIDE values .  

  

In addition to our PRIDE values, UCSF is committed to equity – both in how we deliver care as well as our workforce. We are committed to building a broadly diverse community, nurturing a culture that is welcoming and supportive, and engaging diverse ideas for the provision of culturally competent education, discovery, and patient care. Additional information about UCSF is available here .  

  

Join us to find a rewarding career contributing to improving healthcare worldwide.

The University of California is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, age, protected veteran status, or other protected

Office**Job Description**

**DESCRIPTION:**


Join our collaborative sales team at Thermo Fisher Scientific and contribute as a Academic and Biotech Incubator Bioscience Account Manager (BAM) supporting our legacy Life Technologies research portfolio that includes brands such as Gibco, Invitrogen, Applied Biosystems, Peprotech, eBioscience, Molecular Probes, Dynal, EVOs. You will increase revenue and build lasting relationships with customers while representing our comprehensive portfolio of scientific products and services. BAM portfolio encompasses reagents, consumables and instrumentation spanning across molecular, protein and cell biology. Working in a supportive environment that values achievement and innovation, you'll help enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. The BAM is the cornerstone for our commercial landscape, leading key sales activities around demand generation, closing, account mapping and collaborating with other commercial stakeholders including technical specialists and distribution partners.

**How will you make an impact?**  

This field\-based role is responsible for driving sales growth and managing key accounts across academic, government, and industrial customers within the assigned territory. You will expand existing business, develop new opportunities, and achieve sales targets through strategic account engagement, participation in scientific events, effective prospecting, and strong customer relationships. This role will be home based and requires the individual to be located in the Bay Area: East Bay, San Francisco or Peninsula, serving a territory supporting UC Berkley and biotech incubators in the East Bay and Peninsula.

**What will you do:**

* Consistently achieve or exceed sales targets by maintaining existing business, prospecting to develop incremental business, and conducting cold calls to develop new business in assigned accounts.
* Execute effective sales strategies, including prospecting, qualification, value\-based selling, and closing.
* Leverage product, application, and workflow knowledge to position solutions, deliver technical presentations and demonstrations, and drive customer adoption.
* Manage sales opportunities through disciplined pipeline management, including forecasting, next steps, and close plans
* Maintain strong customer relationships and engage key stakeholders across accounts
* Participate in sales meetings, seminars, and trainings
* Collaborate with internal teams and channel partners to deliver results
* Generate demand through holding office hours, 1:1 meetings, hall walking, business reviews and scientific seminars
* Create scientific intimacy with academic and small biotech companies
* Take market share from competitors

**Operating Cadence and Standard Work:**

* Field based customer engagement is expected 3\-4 days a week. Field location: Berkley, San Francisco, San Carlos
* Maintain a consistent operating rhythm to manage territory performance, including funnel management, account planning, and achieve KPI metrics.
* Routinely update CRM (Salesforce) to ensure accurate forecasting, pipeline health, and visibility to business performance.
* Prepare quarterly account and territory plans to define focused sales strategies and actions to achieve revenue targets, and mitigation plans to close gaps.
* Share market insights, competitive intelligence, and best practices with internal stakeholders.

**Who are we looking for:**

* Bachelor's degree required, preference in the field of Biology.
* 5\+ years of work experience, preferably in wet lab /scientific industries, or 4 years of work experience with a graduate degree
* Strong technical understanding of customer applications and workflows and position our products within the workflow
* Proven track record of achieving or exceeding sales targets in instrumentation, laboratory, or scientific sales
* Demonstrated ability to build strong relationships across all levels of an account and map key stakeholders, decision makers, and influencers.
* Understands the customer’s broader goals and challenges, using value\-based selling to influence decisions, solve business problems, and uncover growth opportunities.
* Experience working in a matrixed, collaborative environment
* Analytical and strategic planning capabilities
* Positive, can\-do attitude and ability to adapt to and embrace change
* Highly motivated to hit sales goals, and take share from competitors
* Fluency in English required; additional languages beneficial
* Commitment to Thermo Fisher's core values of Integrity, Intensity, Innovation and Involvement

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**

* Strong business acumen with ability to translate data into actionable sales strategies
* Strong understanding of academic grant, funding and publication dynamics \& biotech incubator environment
* Excellent communication, presentation and negotiation skills
* High level of personal accountability and rigorous execution discipline
* Proficiency with CRM systems (preferably Salesforce) and Microsoft Office
* Strong understanding of sales funnel management and forecasting
* Valid driver's license and ability to travel up to 25\-50% within assigned territory, with occasional travel outside of territory for training
* Able to lift 50 lbs. independently
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines
* Relocation assistance is NOT provided.
* Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship.

 **Compensation and Benefits**


The salary range estimated for this position based in California is $80,000\.00–$115,000\.00\.
This position may also be eligible to receive a variable annual bonus based on company, team, and/or individual performance results in accordance with company policy. We offer a comprehensive Total Rewards package that our U.S. colleagues and their families can count on, which includes:

new_jobs.description:
Join an elite group of sales professionals bringing customized, white glove experiences directly in the customer’s home. Field Sales Representatives at AT\&T are driven to connect – every interaction is an opportunity to introduce the latest technology and services, thriving on the challenge to make your sales goals happen. With uncapped commission potential, your career and the rewards that come with it are within reach. Enjoy uncapped commission potential as a Field Sales Representative, with top earners having the opportunity to make $100,000\.


Our new Field Sales Representatives earn between $61,800 to $100,000, including the salary and our uncapped commission opportunities. Individual starting salary within this range may depend on geography, experience, expertise, and education/training. Salary range is dependent on if all sales goals are met and/or exceeded.


You’ll be the face and voice of AT\&T to your customers, working independently to deliver personalized sales interactions at scheduled appointments provided to you. You’ll close the deal by offering hands\-on demos, Wi\-Fi assessments, tech delivery and issue resolutions \- keeping customers connected to what matters most to them.

**How you get the job done:**

* We’ll kick things off with paid training –setting you up for success to work independently in the field. Coaching, mentoring and ongoing learning opportunities will keep you on track and tech\-savvy

* Strong verbal communication skills with an ability to build rapport quickly
* Maintain a valid driver’s license—be ready to drive, as we provide a company vehicle for **official business use only**
