new_jobs.title: Inside Sales Representative - Elevator Service and Repair Sales
new_jobs.description:
As a San Francisco\-based independent elevator leader, Star Elevator has spent decades earning the trust of premier property managers, owners, and public agencies throughout the Bay Area. To continue our legacy of exceptional service delivery, we are seeking an Inside Sales Representative to serve as the critical bridge between our clients and our talented field operations team. This role perfectly balances proactive portfolio growth with dedicated client advocacy—acting as your clients’ primary support champion to swiftly resolve operational issues and ensure unmatched satisfaction.

**What You’ll Do – A Day in the Life:**

* Create professional elevator repair or modernization proposals, and manage those opportunities within the CRM system.
* Partner with operations personnel and account managers to ensure technical accuracy and realistic pricing.
* Connect with clients regarding submitted proposals to answer initial feedback and advance the deal.
* Address customer questions about proposal terms, pricing, and project scheduling.
* Interface directly with the repair scheduling department to resolve client timeline conflicts and check capacity.
* Enter account updates and contract details into the company systems to maintain accurate customer profiles, track financial data, and launch project fulfillment.

**What We’re Looking For – Skills to Help You Succeed:**

* High school diploma required; college degree preferred.
* Clear, professional written and verbal English skills.
* Proficient in MS Word and MS Excel.
* Strong service\-oriented mindset and phone etiquette.
* Ability to prioritize and meet tight deadlines.
* Dependable, punctual, and highly accountable.
* Collaborative and able to work well with cross\-functional teams.
* Highly organized with strong attention to detail.

**What We Offer:**

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance; 401(k) and profit\-sharing plan.
* Paid time off, paid holidays, and structured onboarding/training.
* Career development and advancement opportunities within a locally owned company that promotes from within.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**

Star Elevator is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and walks of life.

Pay: $35\.00 \- $45\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40\.0 per week

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

new_jobs.title: Sales Representative Livermore, CA
new_jobs.description:
**Please Note:**


The work territory of this position is the **Livermore, CA area.** You must live less than 1 hour away from the territory (including traffic) or willing to relocate on your own (relocation is not approved for this position) before your hire date.

  

Are you an experienced Sales Professional, Restaurant Manager, Culinary Manager or Chef looking for career development opportunities? Join Sysco’s World Class Sales Team and explore all the benefits and perks.  



  

**Why you should join our Sales Team:**

* Competitive base salary, bonus, plus promotional incentive opportunities
* Car allowance (mileage reimbursement for candidates in CA) and cell phone provided
* Career pathing opportunities for both entry level, and experienced individuals
* Opportunity to be part of a purpose driven organization that supports communities and associates
* Specialized sales training
* Individual as well as team\-based selling
* Opportunity to learn different ethnic segments
* Monthly and annual sales rewards and recognition
* Robust benefits package including an Employee Stock Purchase Plan, \& 401(k) with automatic matching

 **JOB SUMMARY**  

This is an outside sales position responsible for promoting the company's products and services and for building relationships with new and existing accounts. The main focus is to help Sysco customers succeed while achieving sales and profit goals established by the company. This position may require working some non\-traditional hours (evening, weekends, and holidays) to successfully meet customers' needs.  

  

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Develop new business, penetrate existing accounts, and minimize lost business to achieve profitable sales growth and special objectives within assigned territory.
* Seek and qualify prospects following company account stratification goals.
* Research customer business needs and develops a mix of products and service to meet needs.
* Evaluate market trends and recommend products to customers, based on business needs and goals.
* Be informed of market conditions, product innovations, and competitors' products, prices, and sales; share information with customers as part of value\-added services provided.
* Answer customers' questions about products, prices, availability, and product use.
* Provide product information and practical training to customer personnel.
* Drive personal vehicle to customer accounts, conventions, company meetings, etc.
* Communicate and collect accounts receivable as necessary, working with the credit department and client; collect all balances due based on approved credit terms.
* Manage deliveries to the routing schedule published by the transportation department; troubleshoot any problems that occur during the order process (for example, out of stock items, special order items, low inventory, etc.).
* Participate in company functions, promotions, customer visits, and customer events.
* Attend and participate in general sales and district meetings.
* Engage in ongoing training sessions.
* Assist with the training of new employees as requested.
* Review and analyze daily and weekly reports such as special\-order requests, customer bid files, and sales/gross profit margin data.
* Perform administrative duties, such as preparing sales budgets and reports, maintaining sales records, processing credits, and pick\-up requests, preparing sales quotes and menu suggestions, and filing reports.
* Other duties may be assigned.

 **QUALIFICATIONS**

 **Required Education/Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Sales, Marketing, Hospitality, Culinary Arts or related discipline **OR** HSD/GED and 3 years Restaurant Management, B2B or outside sales experience, or equivalent relatable experience.

 **Preferred Qualifications**

* Bi\-Lingual
* Restaurant Management, Foodservice Outside Sales, Chef Experience preferred

 **Certificates, Licenses, and Registrations**

* Valid driver’s license with a driving record that meets company insurability standards.
* Current automobile insurance with the following limits of liability: Bodily injury \- $100,000 each person and $300,000 each accident; property damage \- $100,000 is required

 **Requirement**

* Pass employment testing
* Must sign Sysco Protective Covenants Agreement.
* Reside or willing to relocate to the geographical vicinity of territory.

 **Professional Skills**

* Basic PC skills and proficiency with MS Office.
* Ability to read, write, speak English.

 **Competencies**

* Building Trust
* Building Customer Loyalty
* Follow\-up
* Sales Ability / Persuasiveness
* Managing Work
* Adaptability
* Communication

new_jobs.description:
ADP is hiring a **Sales Representative, Small Business Services.**
Are you ready to build a rewarding future? Uncapped commissions, lavish incentive trips, and career advancement are some of the ways.  

* 

Do you want to join a Fortune 250 company with industry\-leading sales training and the latest sales technology to help you achieve success?  
* 
* Are you looking to join a fast\-paced, inclusive environment with a culture of collaboration and belonging?

If so, this may be the opportunity you've been searching for. Read on and decide for yourself.
  

In this role, you will work within a defined geographic territory that targets clients and prospects with 1\-49 employees. You will identify and sign new clients for payroll, tax, human resources, benefits, and more and sell additional solutions to existing clients. Daily, you will cultivate relationships, set appointments, gather leads from established business partners, assess client or prospect needs to present the best ADP solutions, and spend your time in the field closing business. Don't worry if you have no prior sales experience; we are known for our high\-quality sales training and will teach you how to use the latest sales technology to set you up for success.
  

Integrity, resilience, positivity, and a refuse to lose attitude are must\-haves in this job. As with any role in sales, you will experience ebbs and flows. However, challenges should ignite your determination and invigorate you to thrive, not weigh you down. In return, you'll be rewarded with uncapped commissions, incentive trips, and opportunities to advance your career in a fun and friendly environment \- all while gaining serious credibility as part of an industry\-leading sales team in a stable and highly respected tech company.
  

Ready to \#MakeYourMark? **Apply now!**
  

**To learn more about Sales at ADP,** watch here: http://adp.careers/Sales\_Videos
  

**What you'll do:** Responsibilities
* **Grow Our Business While Growing Yours.** You will work independently and collaboratively as part of various teams within your assigned geography to close sales, win business, and reach sales goals.
* **Turn Prospects into Loyal Clients and Raving Fans.** You will implement a sales strategy targeted to decision\-makers and business owners to build a network and capture new business.
* **Deepen Relationships Across the ADP Family.** In addition to selling cloud\-based human resources solutions, you will strategically cultivate additional business within existing accounts. But it's not all business; you will make life\-long friendships here.
* **Collaborate Daily.** You will serve as a trusted advisor, partner, and ADP ambassador to your clients, internal partners, and overall network while demonstrating grace under pressure and the highest ethical standards.

**TO SUCCEED IN THIS ROLE:** Required Qualifications
* **Positive Self\-Starter.** You have an upbeat, persistent style and the ability to cold call without fear of rejection, manage your time well, and can present your ideas in a clear professional manner on paper, in\-person, and over the phone.
* **Agile Solution Seeker.** You're a problem solver who can find an answer, or a solution, even in times of fast\-paced change.
* **Continuous Learner.** You're always learning, growing, and questioning how things were done in the past to make them even better.
* **Technology \& Digital Acumen.** You are comfortable leveraging modern digital tools and platforms\-including AI\-to work smarter and more efficiently. You adopt new technologies quickly, use data to inform decisions, and continuously explore ways to enhance productivity and results through innovation.

A college degree is great but not required. What's more important is having the skills to do the job. Other acceptable experiences could include:
One to two years of prior work experience or internships in Retail, Marketing, Business Development, Food Service, Insurance Sales, or another relevant industry, OR  

* 
* Military experience We recognize and appreciate the unique talents and experiences Veterans bring to the table. We value the discipline, commitment, and problem\-solving abilities you have developed and are excited to provide an environment where you can continue to make a meaningful impact.

**Bonus points for these:** Preferred Qualifications
Prior quota\-carrying experience  

* 
* Ability to successfully build a network and effectively use social media for sales

**YOU'LL LOVE WORKING HERE BECAUSE YOU CAN:**
* **Be yourself** in a culture that values equity, inclusion, and belonging and creates a safe space for diverse perspectives and insights.
* **Belong** by joining one of our Business Resource Groups where you can connect globally with networks and allies who share common interests and experiences.
* **Grow your career** in an agile, fast\-paced environment with plenty of opportunities to progress.
* **Continuously learn** through ongoing training, development, and mentorship opportunities.
* **Be your healthiest.** Best\-in\-class benefits start on Day 1 because healthy associates are happy ones.
* **Balance work and life.** Resources and flexibility to more easily integrate your work and your life.
* **Focus on your mental health and well\-being.** We're here to provide exceptional service to our clients, and none of that happens without each of us taking care of ourselves and being there for one another.
* **Join a company committed to giving back** and generating a lasting, positive impact upon the communities in which we work and live.
* **Get paid to pay it forward.** Company\-paid time off for volunteering for causes you care about.

**About Suno**
==============


We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world.


Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible.


Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).

**About the Role**
==================


Suno is looking for a Workplace Project Coordinator to help deliver a fast\-moving portfolio of workplace and real estate projects. Working closely with our Senior Workplace Project Manager, you’ll turn decisions into action, keep dependencies visible, and make sure the people involved know what needs to happen next.


This is a 6 month contract engagement. This is an execution\-focused role for someone who can coordinate confidently with vendors, consultants, onsite teams, and senior stakeholders. You’ll support several projects at once, maintain reliable project information, and flag risks before they affect delivery.


You’ll work with direction on major project decisions. As you learn the projects and build trust with the team, you may take ownership of smaller workstreams and set working\-level deadlines, while escalating decisions that materially affect schedule, cost, or scope.


Check out the song we made about it: https://suno.com/s/a5dHdj40vORMQErR

**What You'll Do**
==================

* Support the Senior Workplace Project Manager by driving day\-to\-day execution, follow\-through, and coordination across active projects
* Drive follow\-up and execution on decisions made across active projects
* Track actions, dependencies, deadlines, risks, and outstanding information
* Coordinate meetings, recaps, communications, and accountability for next steps
* Maintain project trackers, documentation, and status information
* Coordinate deliveries and installations in partnership with onsite office teams
* Follow up with vendors, consultants, and internal stakeholders for required inputs and deliverables
* Surface risks, missed dependencies, or potential schedule impacts early
* Support multiple concurrent workplace projects without losing visibility across workstreams
* Travel occasionally to support project milestones, site activities, installations, and office openings as needed

**Who You Are**
===============

* 3\-5 years of relevant experience in workplace buildouts, owner’s rep/project coordination, commercial construction, corporate real estate, facilities projects, or a related environment
* Experience working within a layered project structure, supporting a Senior Project Manager or similar project lead while owning day\-to\-day coordination and execution
* Experience coordinating across multiple vendors, consultants, and senior/executive stakeholders
* Working familiarity with drawings, construction/project terminology, schedules, furniture, IT/AV, procurement, and design documentation
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Comfortable working across multiple projects simultaneously in a fast\-changing environment
* Office, workplace, interiors, or hospitality project experience is a plus

----------------


$62–$83 per hour

We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis under provincial, federal, state, and local laws, regulations, or ordinances. * Building Trust

**Operations Coordinator: Logistics, Parts \& Billing**  
Eagle Americas Corporation, Arlington Heights, IL (Hybrid)

**About Us**

Eagle Americas Corporation (EAC) is the U.S. subsidiary of Eagle, a Poland\-based manufacturer of high\-performance industrial fiber laser cutting systems. EAC sells, installs, services, and supports Eagle machines for fabricators across the United States. We're a growing, hands\-on team, and this role sits at the center of how machines, parts, and paperwork move through the business.

**The Role**

We're looking for an Operations Coordinator to handle the day\-to\-day flow of our business: getting machines and spare parts from Europe to our warehouse and customers, keeping parts inventory accurate and stocked, and making sure every service visit, part, and install is invoiced promptly and correctly. You'll report directly to the COO and work closely with our field service technicians, our parent company in Poland, freight carriers, and customs brokers.

**What You'll Do**

*Logistics and Import*

* Coordinate inbound shipments of machines and spare parts from Europe, including freight booking, tracking, and delivery scheduling to our warehouse or directly to customer sites.
* Work with customs brokers to manage import documentation, including commercial invoices, bills of lading, and customs declarations, and keep tariff classifications accurate.
* Compare freight carriers and rates, and manage domestic shipping of parts to customers and field technicians.

*Spare Parts Management*

* Maintain spare parts inventory, including receiving, stocking, cycle counts, and reconciliation between physical stock and our systems.
* Process customer parts orders from quote through shipment and billing.

*Customer Invoicing and Billing*

* Invoice customers for service visits, parts, and installation work, using technician hours, travel, and expense records to build accurate invoices.
* Keep the chain from estimate to sales order to invoice clean in QuickBooks Online, and track open invoices through collection.
* Work down any billing backlog and keep completed work from sitting unbilled.

*Coordination*

* Support scheduling of installations, commissioning, and service visits with the field team, and keep service records current in our systems.
* Serve as a reliable point of contact for customers on order, shipment, and billing questions.

**What We're Looking For**

*Required*

* 3\+ years in logistics, import/export, parts or inventory management, or operations coordination, ideally for capital equipment or industrial machinery.
* Hands\-on experience with import documentation and working with customs brokers.
* Experience invoicing customers and managing billing or accounts receivable.
* Proficiency with accounting, ERP, or inventory systems, and strong Excel skills.
* Highly organized, detail\-oriented, and comfortable handling many moving pieces at once in a small\-company environment.
* Clear, professional communication with customers, vendors, and international colleagues.

*Preferred*

* QuickBooks Online experience.
* Background with industrial machinery, machine tools, or laser cutting equipment.
* Experience with Jira or similar ticketing and service\-tracking tools.

**Work Location**

Hybrid, based at our Arlington Heights, IL office, with regular warehouse visits for receiving and inventory work.

Pay: $45,000\.00 \- $75,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Health savings account
* Paid time off
* Retirement plan
* Vision insurance

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Arlington Heights, IL 60005

new_jobs.title: Email Marketing Manager
new_jobs.description:
**Job Description Summary**
===========================


The Email Marketing Manager owns the design, build, deployment, and optimization of the USCAN email channel. Serves as the region’s email subject matter expert, advising marketing and sales on audience, cadence, content, and testing strategies and translating those plans into live, measurable programs in Marketo.**Job Description**
===================

**Roles and Responsibilities**

* **Own the USCAN always\-on email portfolio.** Build, maintain, monitor, and optimize the region’s recurring, trigger\-based email programs, including recycled leads, abandoned cart, welcome series, etc. Ensure each program operates reliably, trigger logic remains accurate, and performance insights are surfaced proactively.
* **Strategize, develop, and optimize email tactics** to find, acquire, nurture, convert, and retain prospects. Integrate the insights to refine segmentation and advance personalization and performance.
* **Build and deploy programs in Marketo.** Construct programs, smart campaigns, triggers, smart lists, and static lists. Maintain campaign naming conventions and UTM tracking to preserve reporting and attribution.
* **Advise, don't just execute.** Serve as the email consultant for internal stakeholders across sales and marketing. Speak knowledgeably about cadence, audience definition, content sequencing, subject lines, and related email strategy. Bring historical performance data into campaign planning early so recommendations are incorporated proactively rather than introduced as reactive changes late in the process.
* **Own email governance and program health**. Maintain and enforce email partnership guidelines and the pre\-send checklist. Protect sender reputation and deliverability. Escalate and, when warranted, pause activation because of regulatory or compliance concerns, consent or privacy uncertainty, destination\-domain concerns, broken tracking or attribution, accessibility issues, or unusual unsubscribe and spam\-complaint trends.
* **Design and run experiments.** Write and execute A/B testing briefs with defined hypotheses, single\-variable discipline, fixed testing windows, and stated success criteria. Report results against the approved brief, make clear recommendations for next steps, and keep documented record of what was learned
* **Report on the channel.** Produce quarterly USCAN email performance reports by segment and sub\-business code, measured against program benchmarks for deliverability, open rate, click rate, and unsubscribe rate. Interpret the results and identify content gaps, audience fatigue, and optimization opportunities rather than simply reporting performance changes.
* **Execute event email programs.** Deliver pre\-show, in\-show, and post\-show email sequences for USCAN events and conferences, as well as the operational email communications that accompany webinars, such as confirmations, reminders, and thank\-you emails.
* **Keep the operational foundation accurate**. Maintain lead source, lead source type, campaign type, and Marketo channel taxonomy so email\-sourced leads are routed and reported on accurately. Source and clean operational data feeds and exclude test and internal records before import.
* **Move work through the approval process.** Route email assets through brand, accessibility, and compliance review as required. Manage intake and status in Workfront so requesting teams have visibility into campaign progress.
* **Raise the standard.** Maintain USCAN email best\-practice guidance covering subject line and preheader construction, body copy optimized for skimmers, single\-CTA discipline, visual hierarchy, mobile\-first and responsive design, accessibility and alt text, and the distinction between nurture and drip campaigns.

 **Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree from an accredited university or college, or a high school diploma/GED with at least six years of hands\-on B2B email marketing and marketing automation experience.
* Demonstrated experience building and deploying campaigns directly in Marketo. This is a hands\-on build role; platform administration experience alone does not meet this requirement.
* Demonstrated experience owning always\-on, trigger\-based, or lifecycle email programs, rather than only executing campaign\-by\-campaign ad hoc sends.
* Demonstrated ability to report email performance against benchmarks, translate results into recommendations, and connect those recommendations to commercial outcomes.
* Experience with a template\-based email build tool like Knak.

 **Desired Characteristics**

* Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to document, plan, and execute programs effectively.
* Marketo Business Practitioner certification or above.
* Experience with Workfront or similar project management software
* Working knowledge of email deliverability and sender reputation, including authentication, list hygiene, engagement\-based sending, and complaint thresholds.
* Familiarity with email accessibility standards and mobile\-first, responsive design.
* Experience with a template\-based email build tool like Knak.
* Experience operating in a regulated or medically reviewed content environment, including MLR or Veeva\-type approval workflows.
* Experience with Salesforce and lead source and campaign taxonomy governance across a Marketo–CRM integration.
* Experience partnering with sales development or inside sales teams on email sequences and recycled\-lead programs.
* Comfort operating as the single named owner of a channel, including setting standards, saying no with a clear rationale, and serving as the primary point of contact for email\-related questions.
* Experience in healthcare, medical device, or another regulated B2B industry.


We will not sponsor individuals for employment visas, now or in the future, for this job opening. For U.S. based positions only, the pay range for this position is $98,560\.00\-$147,840\.00

new_jobs.title: Sales Representative II - UE Sports Specialization

At Zimmer Biomet, we believe in pushing the boundaries of innovation and driving our mission forward. As a global medical technology leader for nearly 100 years, a patient’s mobility is enhanced by a Zimmer Biomet product or technology every 8 seconds.


As a Zimmer Biomet team member, you will share in our commitment to providing mobility and renewed life to people around the world. To support our talent team, we focus on development opportunities, robust employee resource groups (ERGs), a flexible working environment, location specific competitive total rewards, wellness incentives and a culture of recognition and performance awards. We are committed to creating an environment where every team member feels included, respected, empowered and recognised.

**What You Can Expect**
-----------------------


Responsible for attaining sales goals and objectives through the creation and execution of a sales plan in the assigned area. This position will drive sales growth through communication and in\-person interactions with current and prospective customers regarding Zimmer Biomet products. This position may mentor/lead other less experienced sales team members.**How You'll Create Impact**
----------------------------


* + Builds strong relationships with key surgeons in the given area, while able to cover orthopedic procedures with clinical proficiency and business acumen.
	+ Builds and implements a sales plan for the assigned area, manages and tracks customer sales activity and prospective customer initiatives, achieves sales targets, reports on sales progress and competitor and customer activities to sales leader, and utilizes the s
	+ Plans, coordinates and executes local educational and sales events, with the support of other internal resources, intended to augment the business and help to deliver assigned sales goals.
	+ Supports referral network of key surgeons and works with key surgeons to educate referrals on Zimmer Biomet products.
	+ Strictly adheres to all laws and Zimmer Biomet policies and SOPs regarding the interaction with HCP’s (Health Care Professionals), product handling and complaints, expense reporting, sales activities and training.
	+ Provides after hour and/or evening case coverage and add on case coverage for team and/or territory. Includes weekend and on\-call case coverage and add on case coverage for team and/or territory.
	+ Collaborate with and provide sales support for team and/or territory, which includes the transportation of Zimmer Biomet instruments and implants for day, evening, add on or weekend cases.
**What Makes You Stand Out**
----------------------------


* In\-depth understanding of customers and their requirements.
* Ability to mentor others based on proven sales track record with customers.
* Ability to become technically proficient with the complete portfolio of products.
* Demonstrated ability to communicate with and influence others
* Willing and capable of carrying weights up to 50 pounds, independently.
**Your Background**
-------------------


* Bachelor’s degree preferred, plus a minimum of 4 years’ proven experience in orthopedic sales, or a minimum of 8 years’ proven sales experience in the medical device industry.
**Travel Expectations**
-----------------------


* Up to 95% predominantly by car, depending on territory.Up to 20% overnight travel may be required.

new_jobs.title: Customer Sales Representative
new_jobs.description:
Customer Sales Representative

**Naperville, IL \| Full\-Time \| W2**  
**$800–$1,200 Per Week \| Weekly Pay \| Paid Training \| Commission Opportunity**

Good With People? Put That Skill to Work.

Some people are naturally good at talking to others.

They know how to start a conversation, ask the right questions, listen and make complicated choices easier to understand.

If that sounds like you, our client is expanding its customer\-facing sales team in the Naperville, IL market and is hiring a **Customer Sales Representative**.

This is a full\-time position combining **customer service, retail sales, relationship building and account development**.

Previous telecommunications or wireless experience is not required.

**Paid training is provided.**

What You'll Actually Be Doing

This is an active, people\-facing position.

You won't spend your entire day behind a register or sitting at a desk.

Instead, you'll interact directly with customers inside partnered retail locations.

Your responsibilities include:

* Greeting and engaging customers face\-to\-face
* Starting natural, professional conversations with shoppers
* Building rapport and creating a positive customer experience
* Asking questions to understand individual household needs
* Learning about customers' current internet, mobile and connectivity services
* Educating customers on available AT\&T products and services
* Explaining current options, features, pricing and promotions clearly
* Helping customers compare available solutions
* Generating qualified customer interest and sales opportunities
* Recommending services based on individual customer needs
* Answering customer questions
* Guiding interested customers through the enrollment process
* Maintaining accurate customer and account information
* Building relationships throughout the customer experience
* Developing strong working relationships with retail employees and store leadership
* Maintaining current product and promotional knowledge
* Tracking customer interactions and individual sales activity
* Working toward individual and team performance goals
* Participating in ongoing customer service, product and sales training

Great Sales Starts With a Conversation.

We're not looking for someone who can memorize a pitch.

We're looking for someone who can understand a customer.

What are they currently using?

What are they paying for?

How many people and devices are connected in their home?

Are they streaming, gaming or working remotely?

What matters most when they're choosing a service?

You'll learn how to move naturally through:

**Conversation → Discovery → Education → Recommendation → Enrollment**

The goal is to understand first and recommend second.

That's **consultative sales**, and it's a skill that translates far beyond telecommunications.

Compensation$800–$1,200 Per Week

**Weekly Pay \| Full\-Time \| W2 \| Paid Training**

Performance\-based commission opportunities are available.

Actual compensation within the advertised range depends on experience, individual performance and the applicable compensation structure.

Complete compensation details are reviewed during the interview process.

No Telecom Experience? No Problem.

Products can be taught.

We're hiring for the qualities that are harder to teach:

**Communication. Confidence. Reliability. Coachability. Work Ethic.**

You may be a strong fit if you:

* Enjoy meeting and talking with new people
* Can confidently initiate conversations
* Naturally build relationships
* Have strong customer service instincts
* Listen before recommending a solution
* Communicate clearly and professionally
* Enjoy working toward measurable goals
* Are motivated by performance and earning potential
* Take coaching and feedback well
* Are dependable and team\-oriented
* Want opportunities for professional growth
* Are comfortable working in an active retail environment
* Have full\-time availability
* Can work weekends as required by the retail schedule

Your Experience May Be More Relevant Than You Think

You don't need a traditional sales background.

Candidates with experience in the following areas often transition well:

**Customer Service**  Retail **Restaurants**  Serving **Bartending**  Hospitality **Front Desk**  Electronics **Wireless**  Cell Phone Sales **Fitness**  Athletics **Events**  Promotions **Marketing**  Customer Relations **Account Support**  Sales

Recent graduates and entry\-level candidates are encouraged to apply.

Pay: $800\.00 \- $1,200\.00 per week

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid training
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

new_jobs.description:
Executive Assistant I opportunity to support executive level VP at our Administrative Offices in Oak Brook, IL.

 **Experience Required:**

Typically requires 4 years in an administrative assistant position; 2 years executive\-level experience preferred.

 **Knowledge, Skills \& Abilities Required:**

* Advanced time management and prioritization.
* High degree of confidentiality and discretion.
* Independent problem\-solver and demonstrated ability to take initiative.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills. Demonstrated ability to tactfully and effectively communicate with various individuals, including highly visible customers/leaders.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word).
* Ability to create and compile complex documents and presentations.
* Organizational ability and attention to detail.
* Effective presentation skills.

 **Major Responsibilities:**

* Provides executive\-level administrative support, including complex calendar management, travel, event coordination, and project support.
* Manages travel arrangements and expense reporting on executive’s behalf.
* Organizes all aspects of meetings, events, and travel, including (but not limited to) agenda preparation, site selection, and document development.
* Greets/meets with high\-level visitors, representing the executive leader and serving as their liaison for organizational initiatives.
* Initiates communications with other leaders as they relate to operational, strategic, and substantive matters. Addresses administrative/operational inquiries, resolves problems, and prioritizes needs using in\-depth knowledge of policies and procedures.
* Develops complex documents and correspondence independently or with executive input.
* Prepares special reports, independently conducting needed research, and compiling, analyzing, and summarizing information. May present this material/information to others.
* Establishes and maintains filing systems and confidential records. Operates and maintains office equipment; may order supplies as needed.
* Assists with departmental budget administration.
* Opens, reads, and prioritizes mail, composing and initiating return correspondence on behalf of the executive as appropriate.
* Serves as a resource for other administrative staff, answering questions and providing training.

 **Education Required:**

* High School Graduate

 **Physical Requirements and Working Conditions:**

* Normal office environment; occasional lifting up to 20 lbs.
* Prolonged periods of sitting, standing, and keyboard use.

 *This job description indicates the general nature and level of work expected of the incumbent. It is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities required of the incumbent. Incumbent may be required to perform other related duties.*
